name: Moon Blessing
description:
Each time Miya's Basic Attack hits a target, she gains 5% Attack Speed for 4s (up to 5 stacks).

At maximum stacks, each Basic Attack also summons a Moonlight Shadow to attack the target, dealing 25 (+20% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, inheriting 20% Attack Effects.

name: Moon Arrow
description:
Miya's Basic Attacks shoot 2 extra Split Arrows, each inheriting 30% of Attack Effects. They deal 10 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the primary target and 30% damage to other targets.

This effect lasts 4s.

name: Arrow of Eclipse
description:
Miya calls upon the power of Moon Eclipse in the target area, dealing 270 (+45% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies within and immobilizing them for 1.2s.

The attack then splits into 6 arrows that scatter in different directions. Each arrow deals 40 (+20% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slows enemies hit by 30% for 2s.

name: Hidden Moonlight
description:
Miya removes all debuffs and enters the Conceal state, gaining 65% Movement Speed for up to 2s (attacking ends the state early).

Upon exiting the Conceal state, Miya gains maximum stacks of Moon Blessing.

name: Bloodthirst
description: Balmond recovers 5% upon killing a minion or creep, and 10% upon a hero kill or assist.

name: Soul Lock
description:
Balmond charges in the target direction, dealing 150 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way.
He stops upon hitting an enemy hero, knocking them back and slowing them by 40% for 3s.

name: Cyclone Sweep
description:
Balmond gains 15% Movement Speed and spins with his axe for 3s, dealing 30 (+1.3% Max HP) (+25% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage per hit to nearby enemies up to 14 times.

Each hit reduces the target's by 5% (up to 40%).

name: Lethal Counter
description:
Balmond unleashes a powerful strike in a target direction, dealing 150 (+70% Total Physical Attack) (+ 30% of the target's lost ) as True Damage. This skill can only be interrupted by Suppression.

Damage dealt to non-hero units is capped at 1000 True Damage.

name: Enemy's Bane
description: Each time Saber deals damage, he reduces the target's by 3-8 for 5s (up to 5 stacks).

name: Orbiting Swords
description:
Saber releases 5 swords that orbit around him and deal 75 (+25% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies on hit. The swords will retract back to him after the duration.

While active, Sword attacks deal 200 (+50% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target and 50% damage to enemies along the path (damage reduced to 50% against minions). Each sword attack reduces the cooldowns of Orbiting Swords by 0.5s and Charge by 1s.

name: Charge
description:
Saber dashes in the target direction, dealing 75 (+50% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the path.

After the dash, he gains an Enhanced Basic Attack that allows him to charge at the target, dealing 75 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing them by 60% for 1s.

name: Triple Sweep
description: Saber charges at the target enemy hero, knocking them airborne for 1.2s (unaffected by Resilience). He strikes them 3 times over the duration, dealing 120 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage with the first 2 strikes and 240 (+160% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage with the third.

name: Crimson Blood Banquet
description:
Alice gains 1 stack(s) of Crimson each time her skill hits an enemy, lasting 4s (up to 2 stacks). Blood Banquet activates at max stacks.

Blood Banquet: Every 0.5s, Alice deals 25 (+30% Total Magic Power) (+ 0.5% - 2.5% target's , scaling with level) Magic Damage to nearby enemies. She also recovers 10 (+3% Extra Max HP) HP and gains 8% Movement Speed. Its duration is refreshed when her skills hit an enemy hero.
Damage to creeps is capped at 70 (+10*Hero Level) Magic Damage.

name: Crimson Gleam
description:
Alice shoots Blood Energy forward, dealing 100 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies.

Use Again: Before Blood Energy dissipates, Alice can recast this skill as Scarlet Shadow to blink to its location.

name: Doom Waltz
description:
Alice performs a deadly dance, dealing 350 (+130% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 70% for 1s.

If Blood Banquet is active, the skill also scorches enemies, dealing 300% of Blood Banquet's damage and recovering the same amount of HP.

name: Throne of Ruin
description:
Alice surrounds herself with blood, gaining Control Immunity and 50% Damage Reduction while slowing herself by 50%.

After 1.5s, she descends from above, dealing 500 (+200% Total Magic Power) (+20% Extra Max HP) Magic Damage to all enemies in range and immobilizing them for 1s.

While charging her Ultimate, Alice cannot use any hero skills other than Scarlet Shadow.

name: Molina's Gift
description:
Upon taking fatal damage, Molina's Gift removes all debuffs from Nana and transforms her for 2s. While transformed, Nana is immune to all damage, gains 30% Movement Speed, and recovers 10% per second, but cannot cast skills.
This effect can trigger only once every 150s.

name: Magic Boomerang
description:
Nana hurls her Magic Boomerang in the target direction, dealing 300 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies it hits as it travels out and returns.

The first enemy hit takes full damage. Damage is reduced by 10% each additional enemy hit, up to a maximum total reduction of 70%.

name: Molina Smooch
description:
Nana throws Molina at the target location, dealing 250 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies within range and Transforming enemy heroes hit into small animals.

If Molina does not hit an enemy hero, she will remain on the ground and chase the nearest enemy hero that comes into range, Transforming the first enemy hero she touches.

Transform: Reduces the target's Movement Speed by 50% and by 30% for 1.5s. Transformed heroes cannot attack or use skills.

name: Molina Blitz
description:
Nana summons Molina to strike the target area 3 times, each dealing 440 (+140% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing enemies in the area by 30% for 1s.

Consecutive hits from Molina Blitz on the same enemy stun them for 1s.

name: Fearless
description:
Tigreal gains 1 stack of Fearless each time he is hit by a Basic Attack. At 4 stacks, he consumes them to block the next incoming Basic Attack (including attacks from Turrets).
He also gains 1 stack of Fearless each time he casts a skill.

Damage from minions does not add or consume Fearless stacks.

name: Attack Wave
description: Tigreal smashes the ground with his hammer, sending a shockwave that erupts 3 times in a fan-shaped area. Each eruption deals 270 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and slows them by 20% / 40% / 60% for 1.5s.

name: Sacred Hammer
description:
Tigreal charges in the target direction, dealing (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way and pushing them to the end of the charge.

Use Again: Tigreal can use this skill again within 4s, dealing 280 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in front of him and knocking them airborne for 0.6s.

name: Implosion
description:
Tigreal unleashes the power of his hammer, pulling nearby enemies to him, dealing 600 (+130% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and stunning them for 1.8s.

The first half of the channeling can be interrupted by control effects, while the second half can only be interrupted by Suppression.

name: Pursuit
description:
After each skill cast, Alucard's next Basic Attack allows him to dash to the target and deal (+125% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

Demon Hunter: Alucard deals 110% damage to creeps.

name: Groundsplitter
description: Alucard jumps to the target area and slashes, dealing 270 (+85% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies within the area and slowing them by 40% for 2s.

name: Whirling Smash
description: Alucard launches a whirling slash, dealing 345 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies.

name: Fission Wave
description:
Passive: Alucard permanently gains 10% Hybrid Lifesteal.

Active: Alucard absorbs the energy of enemies in the target area, reducing their Movement Speed by 30% and by 10. He gains 10 for each enemy hero hit and reduces the cooldown of his other skills to 50% for 6s.

Use Again: Alucard releases a powerful shockwave forward, dealing 400 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

name: Shadow Combo
description:
Karina's third consecutive attack against the same enemy deals 100 (+ 5 (+2.5% Total Magic Power)% target's Lost ) extra True Damage.

If the target is an enemy hero, this attack also reduces the cooldowns of her non-Ultimate skills by 1.5s.
Damage dealt to creeps is capped at 2000 True Damage.

name: Dance of Blades
description:
Karina enters the Dance of Blades state for up to 3.5s, gaining 45% Movement Speed and blocking all Basic Attacks. Blocked attacks trigger a counterattack that deals 100 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the attacker (firing a Shadowblade at ranged attackers or triggering Dance of Blades against melee attackers).
This effect has a 0.4s cooldown).

Casting a Basic Attack or Shadow Assault ends the Dance of Blades state, empowering Karina's next Basic Attack to deal 160 (+60% Total Magic Power) critical Magic Damage and slow the target by 45% for 1s.

name: Dance of Death
description: Karina launches a spinning slash, dealing 375 (+125% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies.

name: Shadow Assault
description:
Karina dashes to the enemy hero, dealing 350 (+160% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, applying a Shadow Sigil to the target, and leaving a Shadowform behind them.

The Shadow Sigil and Shadowform both last 5s. If the target dies during this time, this skill's cooldown resets immediately.

Use Again: Karina dashes back to the Shadowform's location, dealing 150 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies along the way.

name: Tai Chi
description:
Akai gains a 25 (+5% Max HP) shield for 4s on each skill cast.

His skills apply a Mark to targets. His next Basic Attack against a marked target deals 35 (+6% Max HP) extra Physical Damage.

name: Headbutt
description:
Akai charges in the target direction, dealing 300 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way.

Upon hitting an enemy hero, he knocks them airborne for 0.5s and can roll once in the joystick's direction.

Akai can cast Headbutt during Heavy Spin to quickly reposition himself.

name: Body Slam
description: Akai slams his body into the ground, dealing 270 (+6% Max HP) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 45% for 2s.

name: Heavy Spin
description:
Akai spins for 4s, continuously dealing 100 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and knocking them back. Knocked-back enemy heroes also knock back any enemy heroes they collide with.

Upon casting, Akai removes all debuffs and gains slow immunity. While spinning, his Movement Speed gradually increases to 70%.

This skill can only be interrupted by Suppression.

name: Wasteland Force
description:
If Franco takes no damage for 5s, he gains 10% Movement Speed, recovers 1% per second, and begins gaining Wasteland Force (up to 10 stacks).
Franco's next skill consumes all Wasteland Force stacks, increasing its damage by up to 150%.

name: Iron Hook
description: Franco launches an Iron Hook in the target direction. The hook snags the first enemy unit hit, dealing 400 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and dragging them to him.

name: Fury Shock
description: Franco lashes out, dealing 300 (+ 4% of his ) Physical Damage to nearby enemies, slowing them by 70% for 1.5s.

name: Bloody Hunt
description: Franco suppresses the target enemy hero for 1.8s and strikes them 6 times over the duration, each time dealing 50 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

name: Shark Bite
description: Bane infuses his weapon with a stack of Power of Tide each time he uses a skill (up to 2 stacks). Each of his subsequent Basic Attacks consumes a stack to deal (+95% Total Physical Attack) (+ 4 (+0.4*Hero Level)% target's ) Physical Damage to nearby enemies.

name: Crab Claw Cannon
description:
Bane fires his Crab Claw Cannon in the target direction, dealing 150 (+160% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit and then 150% damage to a random enemy behind them (prioritizes enemy heroes). Enemies hit are slowed by 10 (+10% Total Magic Power)% for 1s.
Every 100 Bane possesses reduces this skill's cooldown by an additional 8%.

name: Sea Ink
description:
Bane swallows a cup of sea ink, recovering HP equal to 200 (+150% Total Magic Power) + 5 (+1.5% Total Magic Power)% of his , and gaining 50% Movement Speed that decays over 2.5s.

Use Again: Bane spits corrosive ink in a fan-shaped area, dealing 140 (+130% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage (up to 200% with charging time).
Every 100 Bane possesses reduces this skill's cooldown by an additional 7%.

name: Deadly Catch
description:
Bane summons a school of sharks to charge in the target direction, dealing 700 (+80% Total Physical Attack) (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit, knocking them airborne for 0.6s, and slowing them by 75% (decays over 3s).
This skill deals 40% damage to turrets.

name: Mecha Legs
description:
Bruno gains 2.5% extra Crit Chance each time he deals damage with his skills (up to 8 stacks).

Bruno has higher Physical Attack but only gains 80% extra Attack Speed from all sources.

name: Volley Shot
description:
Bruno kicks a Powerball on his next Basic Attack, gaining 48% Movement Speed for 1s. It deals 100 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target, and slows them by 30% for 0.5s.

The Powerball then bounces back toward Bruno and lands on the ground. He or allied heroes can retrieve the Powerball for another attack and reduce the cooldown of Slide by 1s.

name: Slide
description: Bruno slides forward, briefly stunning enemies along the way, and gaining a Powerball at the end of the dash.

name: Worldie
description:
Bruno kicks an Energy Ball at a target hero, dealing 200 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. It knocks them back to the edge of Bruno's attack range, stuns them for 0.5s, and slows them by 80% for 2s.

The Energy Ball then bounces among enemy units (up to 10 times), prioritizing enemy heroes. Each bounce deals 100 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

name: Double Shot
description: After each skill cast, Clint's next Basic Attack within 4s penetrates a line of enemies, dealing 150 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. This damage can trigger Attack Effects, and the part affected by can Crit.

name: Quick Draw
description:
Clint fires 5 bullets in quick succession in the target direction, each dealing 250 (+85% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the enemy hit.

The bullets will spread evenly across enemies in a fan-shaped area. Enemies hit by multiple bullets will take less damage after the first bullet.

name: Trapping Recoil
description:
Clint shoots a trap net in the target direction, slightly jumping back while dealing 140 (+30% Total Physical Attack) (+150% Total Magic Power) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit and immobilizing them for 1.2s.

Successfully hitting an enemy reduces the cooldown of this skill by 40%.

name: Grenade Bombardment
description:
Clint launches a grenade in the target direction that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing 280 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing them by 50% for 0.5s.

Clint gains a grenade charge every 10s (up to 3).

name: Divine Resurrection
description:
Rafaela can cast a special skill every 10s. After channeling for 2.5s, she instantly resurrects an ally and increases their Movement Speed by 30% for 5s (taking damage from heroes and Legend Creeps interrupts channeling and puts the skill on base cooldown).
This skill's cooldown is increased by 600% of the target's remaining respawn time, capped at 240s. This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

name: Light of Retribution
description: Rafaela strikes the three nearest enemies with Light of Retribution, dealing them 350 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, briefly revealing their positions, and slowing them by 40% for 1.5s. Enemies hit by Light of Retribution again within 6s will take 20% extra damage (this effect stacks up to 3 times).

name: Holy Healing
description:
Rafaela calls upon Holy Light, recovering 100 (+35% Total Magic Power) HP to nearby allied heroes, plus an additional 150 (+65% Total Magic Power) HP to herself and the most injured allied hero in range. She also increases the Movement Speed of nearby allied heroes by 30% and grants Slow Immunity for 1s.
Every 10 increases the Movement Speed bonus by 1%.

name: Holy Baptism
description: Rafaela unleashes the true power of Holy Light in the target direction, dealing 460 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in a line and stunning them for 1.2s.

name: Superconductor
description: Eudora's skills inflict Superconductor for 5s on non-minion units hit and can trigger additional effects against enemies affected by Superconductor.

name: Forked Lightning
description:
Eudora casts Forked Lightning in a fan-shaped area, dealing 275 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage (increased to 200% against minions) to enemies within.

When hitting targets affected by Superconductor, Eudora forms a lightning chain with the target, gaining 40% Movement Speed during the chain for up to 1s.
The lightning chain deals 10 (+4% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage over time and an additional 275 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage when it ends. If this hit lands, it reduces this skill's cooldown by 50%.

name: Ball Lightning
description:
Eudora hurls an orb of lightning at the target enemy, reducing their by 10 for 1.8s, dealing 300 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, and stunning them for 1s.

If the target is affected by Superconductor, the lightning orb reduces nearby enemies' , deals AOE damage centered on the target, and stuns all nearby enemies.

name: Thunder’s Wrath
description:
Eudora calls down a blast of lightning on the target area, dealing 600 (+160% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to targets at the center. Then it strikes targets outside the center, dealing 300 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.

Every time Thunder's Wrath hits a target affected by Superconductor, it triggers a Thunderburst centered on the Superconductor target after a short delay, dealing 330 (+110% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.

name: Dragon Flurry
description:
After dealing damage 3 time(s) with Basic Attacks or skills, Zilong triggers Dragon Flurry on the next Basic Attack, hitting the target 3 time(s). Each hit deals 80 (+30% Total Physical Attack) Basic Attack Damage and heals himself for 50 (+20% Total Physical Attack) HP.

Zilong's Basic Attack deals 100 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

If the target's HP is below 50%, all damage dealt by Zilong's skills and Basic Attacks is increased by 30.

name: Spear Flip
description: Zilong flings the target enemy over his head, dealing 250 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

name: Spear Strike
description:
Zilong lunges at the target enemy, dealing 250 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and reducing their by 15 for 2s.

The cooldown of Spear Strike is reset each time Zilong kills an enemy.

name: Supreme Warrior
description:
Zilong removes all slow effects on himself and gains 40% Movement Speed, 35% Attack Speed, and Slow Immunity for 7.5s.

During this time, Dragon Flurry triggers every 2 attacks (instead of the previous 3).

name: Air Superiority
description: During flight, Fanny deals 10%-20% extra damage to enemies hit (scales with flying speed) and applies a stack of Prey Mark to them (up to 2 stacks) on each attack. Her subsequent skill hits on marked enemy heroes restore 8 energy per stack for her. The energy restoration is reduced if she hits multiple enemy heroes within a short period of time.

name: Tornado Strike
description: Fanny whirls her blades, dealing 275 (+85% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies.

name: Steel Cable
description:
Fanny shoots a cable in the target direction that pulls her to the first obstacle hit. She can cast this skill again within 2s until her energy runs out, and each successive recast within this period costs 2 less energy.

Fanny automatically casts Tornado Strike upon hitting an enemy mid-flight, as long as her energy is sufficient.

name: Cut Throat
description: Fanny leaps at the target enemy hero or Creep with her blades, dealing 400 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Each stack of Prey Mark on the target increases this damage by 30%.

name: Malefic Gun
description: Layla deals increased damage to targets farther away from her (starting at 100% and increasing to 115% at 6 units away). This does not apply to Turrets.

name: Malefic Bomb
description:
Layla fires a Malefic Bomb in the target direction, dealing 200 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit (can Crit).

Upon hitting an enemy, Layla's Basic Attacks and Void Projectile gain extra range for 3s, and she gains 60% extra Movement Speed that decays over 1.2s. The duration of the Movement Speed boost is doubled if an enemy hero is hit.

name: Void Projectile
description:
Layla fires an orb of Malefic Energy at the target, dealing 170 (+65% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target and nearby enemies and applying a Magic Mark to the target for 3s.
When Layla hits an enemy with a Magic Mark, she deals 100 (+35% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target and nearby enemies, stunning them for 0.25s.

name: Destruction Rush
description:
Passive: The range of Void Projectile and Basic Attacks is increased by 0.6 units. Layla's sight range is slightly increased each time this skill is upgraded.
Active: Layla fires a blast of Malefic Energy in the target direction, dealing 500 (+150% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a line.

name: Rage Incarnate
description:
After casting a skill, Minotaur gains Motivation, recovering HP equal to 5 (+1*Hero Level)% of damage taken from enemy heroes for 3s.

Enraged State: Motivation HP recovery is increased to 200%.

name: Despair Stomp
description:
Minotaur jumps to the target location, dealing 325 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and briefly knocking them airborne. Enemies hit will also be slowed by 40% while Minotaur enhances his Basic Attacks to deal 25 (+5% Max HP) extra Physical Damage for 2s.

Enraged: Increases the AOE range and the damage dealt by 25 (+5% Max HP) Physical Damage.

name: Motivation Roar
description:
Minotaur heals himself and the nearby ally with the lowest HP, recovering 220 (+60% Total Magic Power) HP for both. He also recovers an additional 8% of his lost .

Enraged: Minotaur heals himself and all nearby allied heroes.

name: Minoan Fury
description:
Minotaur enters Enraged state and smashes the ground 3 times. The first 2 hits deal 180 (+85% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and slow them by 60%, while the final hit deals 200 (+85% Total Physical Attack) True Damage and knocks targets airborne for 0.8s. Minotaur is immune to control effects during this attack.

The Enraged state lasts 12s and enhances Minotaur's skills for the duration.

name: Noumenon Energy Core
description: Every 6s to 3s (scales with Noumenon Blast level), the Noumenon Energy Core grants Lolita 20 (+2.5% Max HP) (+20% Total Magic Power) shield. When Lolita casts a skill, the Noumenon Energy Core grants Lolita and nearby allied heroes an extra shield. This shield can stack up to 3 times and lasts 30s.

name: Power Charge
description: Lolita dashes in the target direction. Her next Basic Attack within 4s will perform a short dash to the target, dealing 400 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and stunning them for 0.5s. This damage is doubled against Minions.

name: Guardian's Reflection
description:
Lolita raises her shield and reflects all incoming ranged Basic Attacks and Projectiles in the direction of the shield for 3s. The shield will break after taking 1000 (+15% Max HP) damage.

The damage and effects from the Unique Passives of an attacker's equipment will not apply to the shield and will not be reflected. This skill can be interrupted by high level control effects.

name: Noumenon Blast
description:
Passive: Reduces the interval of Noumenon Energy Core by 1s each time this skill is upgraded.

Active: Lolita begins charging for 2s while slowing enemies in a fan-shaped area by 60%. When the charging is complete or is stopped, Lolita slams her hammer on the ground, dealing up to 600 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and stunning them for up to 2s (damage and stun duration scale with charge time).

Use Again: Lolita immediately stops charging and slams her hammer on the ground.

name: Ninjutsu: Trace of Shadow
description: Hayabusa's attacks apply a stack of Shadow Mark on hit (up to 4 stacks). Each stack lasts 6s and increases Hayabusa's damage to the enemy by 5%.

name: Ninjutsu: Phantom Shuriken
description:
Passive: Hayabusa permanently gains 3% Spell Vamp.
Active: Hayabusa throws three returning shurikens in the target direction, each dealing 220 (+75% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 35% for 2s. Subsequent hits on the same enemy deal 70% less damage (only 50% less to creeps). He also restores 10 Energy when hitting non-minion enemies.

name: Ninjutsu: Quad Shadow
description:
Hayabusa dashes in the target direction and releases four phantoms that travel in separate directions. The phantoms will remain at the end of their paths or attach themselves to the first enemy hero hit, dealing 130 (+30% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing them by 40% for 2s. Hayabusa will immediately stop if he hits an enemy hero during the dash.

Use Again: Hayabusa teleports to a phantom's location and reduces the cooldown of Ninjutsu: Phantom Shuriken by 1s. If the phantom is attached to an enemy hero, he also deals 130 (+30% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the enemy.

name: Ougi: Shadow Kill
description:
Hayabusa blends into the shadows and launches 6 single-target attacks on enemies in the area, each dealing 130 (+30% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

The attacks prioritize enemies with Shadow Mark and each will consume a mark to deal 90 (+40% Extra Physical Attack) extra Physical Damage. Shadow Kill does not apply Shadow Mark.

name: Power of Einherjar
description:
Freya gains 1 Sacred Orb with each Basic Attack (up to 6 Sacred Orbs). Consuming 1 Sacred Orb grants Freya 100% Attack Speed for her next Basic Attack (up to 6 stacks).

While out of combat, Sacred Orbs regenerate gradually.

name: Leap of Faith
description: Freya leaps to the target area and strikes the ground with her shield, gaining 500 (+100% Total Physical Attack) shield and dealing 200 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies within while knocking them airborne for 0.4s.

name: Valkyrie Slash
description:
Freya charges forward and slashes, dealing 150 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing enemies by 30% for 0.5s.
This skill has no base cooldown but consumes 2 Sacred Orbs per cast.
It deals 50% damage to creeps.

name: Valkyrie Descent
description: Freya selects a target area and dives down as a Sacred Orb (gaining Control Immunity), dealing 300 (+75% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and 40% slow to enemies in her path and at the landing point for 2s. Upon landing, Freya enters the Valkyrie state for 10s, during which her Basic Attacks deal 30 extra damage (extra damage cannot Crit), she recovers 40 (+40% Total Physical Attack) HP per Basic Attack, and her Basic Attacks deal splash damage.

name: Mystic Favor
description: After Gord hits an enemy 4 times with skills within a short period of time, the next skill damage will deal an additional 120 (+8*Hero Level) (+40% Total Magic Power) True Damage and slow them by 20% for 1s (the slow effect stacks up to 2 times).

name: Mystic Projectile
description: Gord conjures a Mystic Orb that bounces in the target direction and explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing 225 (+65% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the area, while stunning them and revealing their locations for 1s.

name: Mystic Injunction
description: Gord creates an energy field in the target area, dealing 30 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.25s to enemies within (up to 16 times).

name: Mystic Gush
description:
Gord unleashes an energy beam in the target direction, dealing 90 (+32% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit every 0.2s (up to 16 times).

The direction of the beam can be adjusted using the Joystick.

name: Assassin Instinct
description:
If Natalia stays in a bush without taking damage for 1s, she will enter Camouflage state and gain 15% Movement Speed. In this state, Natalia's next Basic Attack will teleport her behind her target and deal 200 (+110% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage while silencing the target for 0.25s.

Dealing damage, taking damage or using skills will immediately end the Camouflage state, but her next Basic Attack will remain enhanced for another 1s.

Natalia's base Crit Damage is reduced to 150%, but her damage to Creeps is increased to 150%.

name: Claw Dash
description:
Natalia dashes in the target direction, dealing 250 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in her path.

After hitting an enemy, she can cast this skill again within 5s.

name: Smoke Bomb
description: Natalia releases a Smoke Bomb at her location, slowing enemies within by 25% while Natalia becomes immune to enemy Basic Attacks for 4s.

name: The Hunt
description:
Passive: Natalia gains 15% Crit Chance.

Active: Natalia immediately enters the Assassin Instinct state. She can store up to 2 Ultimate charges, and each charge has a recharge time of 30s. Killing creeps reduces the remaining recharge time by 50% of the full recharge time.

name: Yin Yang Gathering
description: Upon retrieving the Seimei Umbrella, Kagura gains a 450 (+80% Total Magic Power) shield, stuns nearby enemies for 0.5s, and slows them by 60% for 1s. Cooldown: 4.5s.

name: Seimei Umbrella Open
description:
Kagura sends the Seimei Umbrella to the target location, dealing 365 (+105% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in its path and slowing them by 60% for 0.5s. The Umbrella will automatically return to Kagura when she's too far away.
This skill deals 130% damage to non-hero enemies.

name: Rasho Umbrella Flee
description: Kagura removes all debuffs on her and leaps in the target direction, while leaving the Seimei Umbrella behind.

name: Yin Yang Overturn
description: Kagura invokes the power of the Seimei Umbrella, dealing 250 (+95% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies, knocking them back, and slowing them by 60% for 0.5s.

name: Seimei Umbrella Open
description:
Kagura sends the Seimei Umbrella to the target location, dealing 365 (+105% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in its path and slowing them by 60% for 0.5s. The Umbrella will automatically return to Kagura when she's too far away.
This skill deals 130% damage to non-hero enemies.

name: Rasho Umbrella Flee
description: Kagura teleports to the Seimei Umbrella's location and retrieves it, dealing 300 (+90% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the nearby enemies.

name: Yin Yang Overturn
description: Kagura resets the cooldown of Seimei Umbrella Open, dealing 235 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies around the Seimei Umbrella and slowing them by 60%. After 1.5s, enemy heroes around the umbrella are pulled to the center and take 480 (+155% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.

name: Only Fast
description: After traveling 5 units, Chou deals 180% damage on his next Basic Attack (cannot Crit), briefly slows the target by 90%, and reduces their by 10 (+1*Hero Level) for 3s (up to 2 stacks).

name: Jeet Kune Do
description:
Chou strikes in the target direction, dealing 180 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit. This skill can be cast 3 times before it goes on cooldown. On the 3rd cast, Chou also knocks enemies hit airborne.

Hitting an enemy hero with the 3rd cast resets the cooldown of Shunpo.

name: Shunpo
description: Chou charges in the target direction, gaining Control Immunity and a 200 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) shield.

name: The Way of Dragon
description:
Chou strikes a roundhouse kick at the target enemy hero, dealing them 400 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and knocking them back.

Cast the skill again to chase up the target, dealing a total of 480 (+240% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

name: Simian God
description:
Enemies hit by Sun or his Doppelgangers will have their reduced by 5% (stacks up to 6 times). Sun recovers HP equal to 75 plus 15% of the Doppelganger's Physical Attack each time a Doppelganger deals damage.
Sun or his Doppelgangers' Basic Attacks deal 65 extra damage to creeps.

name: Endless Variety
description:
Sun hurls his Golden Staff in the target direction, dealing 280 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path. Upon hitting an enemy hero or creep or reaching maximum range, the Golden Staff morphs into a Doppelganger that pursues enemies. The Doppelganger inherits Sun's attributes, deals 60% damage, and takes 150% damage for 5s.

This skill shares its level and cooldown with Swift Exchange.

name: Swift Exchange
description:
Sun hurls his Golden Staff in the target direction, dealing 280 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path.

He conjures a Doppelganger at his location that inherits his attributes, deals 60% damage, and takes 150% damage for 5s.
Sun transforms into the Golden Staff and becomes concealed, reappearing at its maximum range.

name: Instantaneous Move
description: Sun commands his Doppelgangers to strike at the target enemy with him, dealing 270 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing the target and enemies behind them by 25% (can be stacked) for 1.5s. This counts as Basic Attack damage and can trigger Attack Effects but cannot Crit.

name: Clone Techniques
description: Sun summons a Doppelganger that inherits his attributes, deals 80% damage, and takes 120% damage for 8s.

name: Beta, Advance!
description:
When Alpha uses a skill, Beta will be summoned to attack. Enemies that are hit by Beta 2 time(s) will be Locked On.

Locked On: After Alpha deals damage to the target, Beta will fire a laser at them, dealing 60 (+50% Total Physical Attack) (+8*Hero Level) True Damage and briefly applying a powerful slow effect.
This skill only deals 75% damage to Creeps.

name: Rotary Impact
description:
Alpha unleashes an energy wave in the target direction, dealing 100 (+90% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path and slowing them by 40% for 1s.

Beta then strafes enemies along the same path, dealing 60 (+30% Extra Physical Attack) True Damage.

name: Force Swing
description:
After a short delay, Alpha swings his blade in the target direction, dealing 180 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area and recovering 80 (+40% Extra Physical Attack) HP for the first enemy hit (healing decays by 40% for each additional enemy hit).

Beta then strafes enemies in the same area, dealing 60 (+30% Total Physical Attack) True Damage.

name: Spear of Alpha
description:
Beta dives to the target location, dealing 100 (+20% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and stunning them for 1s. Alpha then leaps towards the same location, knocking enemies in his path airborne and carrying them to the landing location. Alpha then slams down, dealing 250 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing the enemies by 40% for 1.5s.

Beta then attacks the same area 5 times, dealing 15 (+30% Extra Physical Attack) True Damage each time.

name: Let's Dance!
description:
Ruby's skills have a 75% Spell Vamp Ratio (her Basic Attacks cannot trigger Lifesteal). For every 1% HP lost, her Spell Vamp Ratio increases by 1%, up to 150%.

After each skill cast, Ruby can dash to another location and gain 8-25 (scales with level) for 4s (stacks up to 3 times).

name: Be Good!
description: Ruby swings her scythe, dealing 280 (+110% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit. She then unleashes a shockwave in the same direction, dealing 140 (+55% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 40% for 1s.

name: Don't Run, Wolf King!
description: Ruby swings her scythe around herself twice, each swing dealing 60 (+55% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies, stunning them for 0.5s, and slowly pulling them toward her.

name: I'm Offended!
description: Ruby sweeps her scythe in the target direction, dealing 600 (+200% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit, pulling them toward her, and stunning them for 0.5s.

name: Heavenly Vow
description:
Yi Sun-shin attacks with his longbow or glaive based on his distance from the target.
Weapon Mastery: After each weapon swap, his next 2 Basic Attacks gain extra Attack Speed and deal 70% and 55% Crit Damage respectively. He also gains 15% Movement Speed for 1s.

name: Traceless
description:
Yi Sun-shin dashes forward and slashes with his glaive, dealing 150 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and gaining Control Immunity for 0.4s.
Each Weapon Mastery triggered reduces the cooldown of Traceless by 1s.

name: Blood Floods
description:
Tap: Yi Sun-shin slashes swiftly with his glaive, dealing 240 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
Hold: Yi Sun-shin shoots a powerful arrow forward, dealing 240 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target (damage scales with hold time, up to 200%).
Casting this skill immediately triggers Weapon Mastery.

name: Mountain Shocker
description:
Yi Sun-shin summons a turtle ship and reveals the whole map for 2s. The turtle ship lasts up to 10s, during which he gains 70% burst Movement Speed (decays to 20% over 2s).

Use Again: Yi Sun-shin commands the turtle ship to ram the target area, dealing 160 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the center and stunning them for 0.8s. Meanwhile, he commands the naval fleet to launch 3 waves of cannon attacks over a larger area. Each wave deals 160 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slows enemies by 30%.
Casting this skill immediately triggers Weapon Mastery.

name: Spear of Quiescence
description: Moskov's Basic Attacks can penetrate the target and deal (+68% Total Physical Attack)- (+110% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies behind them (scales with hero level). Each Basic Attack hit reduces the cooldowns of Abyss Walker by 0.8s and Spear of Misery by 0.8s.

name: Abyss Walker
description: Moskov teleports to the target location, increasing his Attack Speed to 1.15 times for 3s. Meanwhile, his Basic Attack deals (+10% Total Physical Attack) more damage to enemies behind the primary target.

name: Spear of Misery
description:
Moskov launches a powerful strike at the target enemy hero or Creep, dealing 300 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, knocking them back, and revealing their position for 2s.

If the target collides with an enemy hero when knocked back, they'll both take 200 (+30% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and be stunned for 1.2s. If the enemy is knocked into a wall, they will also be stunned for the same duration.

name: Spear of Destruction
description:
After a short delay, Moskov throws the Spear of Destruction in the target direction, dealing 340 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path and to the first enemy hero hit. Upon hitting an enemy hero, the spear pierces them, dealing 10% extra Physical Damage to enemies behind them. The target and enemies hit by the piercing damage will be slowed by 50% for 1s (the slow duration scales with the spear's travel time, up to 3s).

When Spear of Destruction hits the first enemy hero, it creates a shadow behind them and refreshes the cooldown of Abyss Walker.

Use Again: Moskov casts Abyss Walker from the shadow's location (shares the same cooldown as the skill).

name: Electro Airbag
description: When Johnson's HP drops below 30%, he gains a 300 (+700% Total Physical Defense) shield for 10s. Cooldown: 100s.

name: Impact Wrench
description: Johnson throws his wrench toward the target location, dealing 120 (+220% Total Physical Defense) Magic Damage to enemies in its path. Enemies around the landing point are stunned for 0.8s.

name: Electromagnetic Waves
description:
Johnson raises his shield, continuously dealing 120 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area in the target direction, reducing their Movement Speed and by 10% (stacks up to 3 times) for 2s.

While his shield is raised, Johnson can perform Basic Attacks and cast skills.

name: Full Throttle
description:
Passive: Johnson's is increased by 10%.
Active: Johnson transforms into a car. Nearby allied heroes can use Hop In to ride with him (only 1 at a time). When the car hits an enemy hero, it explodes and deals 300 (+240% Total Physical Defense)–450 (+360% Total Physical Defense) Magic Damage to nearby enemies, stunning them for 0.5–1s (scales with driving time). It also creates an electrified zone at the location that continuously deals 60 (+20% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slows enemies within.
Johnson's location is revealed to enemies for 3s when he casts this skill.

name: Starlit Hourglass
description: Each time Cyclops hits an enemy with his skills, all his skill cooldowns are reduced by 0.5s.

name: Stardust Shock
description: Cyclops casts two Stardust Disks in the target direction, each dealing 240 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in its path.

name: Planets Attack
description:
Cyclops conjures Starlit Spheres around himself, gaining 50% Movement Speed that decays over 2s.

The Starlit Spheres automatically seek and attack nearby enemies (prioritizing enemy heroes), and explode on contact to deal 200 (+65% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.
Subsequent hits on the same target deal reduced damage.

name: Star Power Lockdown
description: Cyclops creates a Planetary Sphere that tracks the target enemy hero or creep, dealing 500 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and immobilizing them for 0.75-1.5s (scales with Planetary Sphere's travel distance).

name: Scripture of the Moon Elf
description: Scripture of the Moon Elf slowly charges energy for Estes. Upon reaching 100 stacks, it enhances his next Basic Attack, dealing 250 (+100% Total Physical Attack) (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the target. The attack will ricochet to nearby enemies, dealing 125 (+50% Total Physical Attack) (+75% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing them by 60% for 1.5s.

name: Moonlight Immersion
description:
Estes recovers 200 (+110% Total Magic Power) HP for the target allied hero immediately and links himself with them for 5s.
While linked, both heroes gain 15 (+10% Total Magic Power) , and the target slowly recovers 360 (+90% Total Magic Power) HP. Linking with an allied hero increases Estes' Movement Speed by 15%, as well as the energy charging speed of the Scripture of the Moon Elf.
Being too far from the target will break the link.

name: Domain of Moon Goddess
description: Estes drops a flood of moonlight on the target area, dealing 350 (+70% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemy units within it. Afterwards, it turns to a domain of the Moon Goddess and reveals enemies inside it. Enemies will be slowed by 90% for 1.5s if they touch the edge of the domain area. (The slow effect will decay over time.)

name: Blessing of Moon Goddess
description:
Estes casts an enhanced Moonlight Immersion on himself and all nearby allied heroes, refreshing Moonlight Immersion on them and enhancing it for 8s.
Enhanced Moonlight Immersion: Doubles the Instant Basic Healing and Increase, and heals the target for 1020 (+225% Total Magic Power) HP over time.

name: Blessing of Wilderness
description:
Hilda recovers 2% HP per second while in the bush. Entering a bush enhances her next Basic Attack, which deals 110 (+130% Total Physical Attack)(+12*Hero Level) Physical Damage to the target, reduces the target's Movement Speed by 40%, and deals 40 (+100% Total Physical Attack)(+10*Hero Level) Physical Damage to enemies behind the target. After using the enhanced Basic Attack, this effect enters a 6s cooldown.

Hilda's Basic Attack and skills apply a Wilderness Mark on hit, which lasts up to 4s and stacks up to 6 times. Each stack reduces the enemy hero's by 3%.

name: Combat Ritual
description: Hilda gains 60% Movement Speed for 3s and receives a shield that absorbs damage equal to 10% , lasting 3s.

name: Art of Hunting
description: Hilda locks onto an enemy target, dealing 200 (+90% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage per hit. This skill can be cast up to 3 times. The 2nd attack deals extra damage to nearby enemies. The 3rd attack deals damage to the target and nearby enemies, knocking them back briefly.

name: Power of Wildness
description:
Hilda launches a powerful slash at the target enemy, dealing 600 (+250% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and stunning them for 0.2s. Nearby enemies take 60% of the damage.

Each stack of Wilderness Mark increases Power of Wildness's damage by 2.5% of the target's . At max stacks, the extra damage increases to 20% of the target's .

name: Pride of Ice
description:
Upon taking fatal damage, Aurora freezes herself for 1.5s, becoming invincible during this time and gradually recovering 30% . This effect has a 150s cooldown.

Aurora's freeze effects can also affect Turrets.

name: Hailstone Blast
description: Aurora summons an icy meteorite to strike at the target location, dealing 400 (+90% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing targets hit by 40% for 1s. Afterward, 5 hailstones fall, each dealing 40 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.

name: Frosty Breeze
description:
Aurora blows Frosty Breeze in a fan-shaped area in the target direction, dealing 225 (+75% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and creating a frozen area at the far end.

The area deals a total of 225 (+75% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies within and freezes them for 1s (increases by 0.06s for every 100 ).

name: Frigid Glacier
description:
Aurora creates a frost path in the target direction, dealing 100 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the path and slowing them by 80% for 1.2s.

The frost path gradually expands into a glacier that shatters at maximum size, dealing 600 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies in the area and freezing them for 1s (increases by 0.2s for every 100 ).

name: Homeland Defender
description: Lapu-Lapu accumulates 10 Bravery Blessing each time he deals damage (halved for damage dealt to non-hero units). When Bravery Blessing is full, Lapu-Lapu's next Basic Attack will make him dash toward the target, dealing (+150% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage (cannot Crit) and granting him a shield that absorbs 250 (+65*Hero Level) damage for 2.5s.

name: Justice Blades
description:
Lapu-Lapu releases two boomerangs in the target direction, each boomerang dealing 140 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit on its way out and back.

Enemies hit by both boomerangs take 50% damage from the second hit.

name: Jungle Warrior
description: Lapu-Lapu dashes in the target direction, dealing 100 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way.

name: Bravest Fighter
description:
Lapu-Lapu leaps to the target location while combining his twin blades into one, dealing 300 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies upon landing and slowing them by 60% for 1s. (This skill cannot be interrupted.)
Lapu-Lapu gains 3 times the Bravery Blessing from this skill and skills in transformed state.
For the next 10s, Lapu-Lapu enters Great Sword stance and gains enhanced skills, 30 , and his Basic Attack damage is increased to 120%.

name: Land Shaker
description: Lapu-Lapu channels for 0.7s, slowing enemies in the target direction by 60%. He then slams his heavy sword to the ground, dealing 250 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and stunning them for 1s. (This skill can only be interrupted by Suppression.)

name: Storm Sword
description:
Lapu-Lapu whirls his heavy sword, dealing 250 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies.

When hitting an enemy hero, Lapu-Lapu gains 20% Damage Reduction, plus an additional 8% for each extra enemy hero hit, lasting 3s.

name: Raging Slash
description:
Lapu-Lapu swings his heavy sword 3 times. The first two attacks deal 345 (+160% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage each, while the third deals 440 (+210% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a large area.

Lapu-Lapu gains Control Immunity during this process and can change his attack direction and move a short distance on each attack.

name: Nether Touch
description: Vexana and her Eternal Guard inflict Nether Touch on enemies hit. The mark lasts 5s and causes the affected enemy to explode upon death, dealing 108-500 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies (base damage scales with level).

name: Deathly Grasp
description: Vexana unleashes a Deathly Grasp in the target direction, dealing 200 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in its path. It stops upon hitting an enemy hero, Terrifying and knocking them back. After a short delay, it explodes, dealing 200 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and Terrifying them for 1s.

name: Cursed Blast
description: Vexana marks the target area with the power of the undead, striking it after a 0.8s delay and dealing 580 (+165% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit.

name: Eternal Guard
description: Vexana summons an Eternal Guard at the target location, dealing 480 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and knocking them airborne for 0.8s. The Eternal Guard then joins Vexana in battle for 15s. Its attacks deal 200 (+40% Total Magic Power) (+ 5% target's ) Magic Damage and Splash Damage in a large area.

name: Full Moon Curse
description:
Roger can freely switch between human and wolf forms.

In human form, Roger's Basic Attack and skills deal additional damage equal to 4% of the target's current .

In wolf form, Roger's Basic Attack and skills deal additional damage equal to 4% of the target's lost .

This effect can only deal up to 60 additional damage against creeps.

name: Open Fire
description:
Roger fires two quick shots in the target direction, dealing a total of 250 (+125% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the enemy hit.
The first shot is a hunter net that slows the enemy by 80% for 1.5s.
The second is a bullet that reduces the enemy's by 10 for 5s.

name: Hunter's Steps
description: Roger gains 20% Movement Speed and 20% Attack Speed for 2.5s.

name: Wolf Transformation
description:
Roger lunges in the target direction and turns into wolf form, dealing 150 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 90% for 0.8s.

Passive: In wolf form, Roger gains 20 and 25 Movement Speed.

name: Lycan Pounce
description:
Roger lunges at the target enemy, becoming untargetable while dealing 250 (+125% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to up to 3 enemies in the area.

Getting a kill or assist will reduce the cooldown of this skill by 80%.

name: Bloodthirsty Howl
description: Roger lets out a howl, increasing his Attack Speed by 1.15 times for 5s and revealing nearby enemy heroes with HP below 40%. If there are enemy heroes with HP below 40% in range, Roger gains 50% Movement Speed.

name: Restore Human Form
description: Roger rolls in the target direction and reverts back to human form, gaining a 200 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) shield for 1.5s.

name: Lightwheel Mark
description:
Karrie's Basic Attacks and skills apply a stack of Lightwheel Mark on hit.
Once a target has 5 stacks of Lightwheel Marks, the marks will turn into a lightwheel, dealing True Damage equal to 5 (+1% Extra Physical Attack)% of the target's to them (only up to 300 damage against creeps).

name: Spinning Lightwheel
description: Karrie releases a sphere of surging energy in the target direction, dealing 250 (+90% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path. The sphere will stop upon hitting an enemy hero or reaching its max travel distance, continuously dealing 150 (+20% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 80% for 1s.

name: Phantom Step
description:
Karrie dashes in the target direction while throwing a lightwheel at the nearest enemy, dealing 150 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and applying a stack of Lightwheel Mark on them.

When in Dual Wield state, Karrie throws two lightwheels instead.

name: Speedy Lightwheel
description: Karrie enters Dual Wield state for 10s, gaining 20% Movement Speed. Each Basic Attack deals 40 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and throws 2 lightwheels that inherit a portion of Attack Effects.

name: Steel Bones
description:
Gatotkaca gains equal to 2% of his lost HP (up to 200). He gains 5 Rage (up to 100) for every 300 damage taken (calculated before reduction).

Upon reaching 25 Rage, Gatotkaca's next Basic Attack is enhanced, consuming all Rage to deal (+100% Total Physical Attack) (+200% Total Magic Power) (+ 8.2-11 * Consumed Rage) Magic Damage (scales with hero level) and recover (8 * Consumed Rage) HP.

name: Blast Iron Fist
description: Gatotkaca slams the ground, creating a shattered zone in the target direction while dealing 200 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies within. Enemies in the shattered zone will take 100 (+20% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage per second and be slowed by 30%.

name: Unbreakable
description: Gatotkaca begins channeling, then sprints in the target direction with a battle cry, taunting enemies on the path to attack him, dealing 200 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage for 0.9 - 1.5s. The taunt duration and sprint distance scale with the channel time. Canceling the skill reduces 50% of the remaining cooldown.

name: Avatar of the Guardian
description:
Gatotkaca jumps to the target location, dealing 500 (+300% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and knocking them airborne for 1s. Enemies near the center of the area will be knocked airborne for a longer duration, while enemies on the fringes will be pulled to the center.

The camera will move with the skill indicator but won't grant extra sight.

name: Magic Master
description:
Harley's mastery of magic allows his Basic Attacks and skills to reduce the enemy's by 2 and increase his Attack Speed by 5% - 10% (scales with hero level) for 3s on hit. This effect stacks up to 10 times.
Harley's Basic Attacks deal 60 (+50% Total Physical Attack)(+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.

name: Poker Trick
description:
Harley throws 3 waves of cards, 3 cards per wave. Each card deals 120 (+25% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies.
After the same target is hit 3 time(s), the damage will decay to 50% on subsequent hits.

name: Space Escape
description:
Harley blinks in the designated direction, leaving a magic hat at his starting location. His Movement Speed increases by 60% for 2s, then rapidly decays to normal over 4s.

Use Again: Return to the hat's location.

name: Deadly Magic
description: Harley casts a magic ring of fire at an enemy hero, dealing 200 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and a 40% slow effect that decays to 15% after 1.5s. The ring will stay around the target, during which Harley can hit the ring to damage the target. The ring will explode after 4s, dealing Magic Damage equal to 200 (+50% Total Magic Power) plus 30% of the damage taken by the target while the ring was active.

name: Jungle Heart
description:
Irithel and Leo's immaculate teamwork allows her to shoot while moving. Each Basic Attack will shoot 2 crossbow bolt(s) (but takes longer to refill) that deal (+55% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage per bolt (inherits a portion of Attack Effects).
Moving will build up Jungle Heart, up to a maximum of 10 units, and cause the next Basic Attack to unleash 1 additional bolt(s).

name: Strafe
description: Irithel launches a volley of arrows on the target area, dealing 330 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies within and reducing their by 15 for 3s.

name: Force of The Queen
description: Leo lets out a piercing roar, dealing 200 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 40% for 2s.

name: Heavy Crossbow
description: Irithel orders Leo to leap in the target direction and empowers her crossbow for 10s. For the duration, she gains 30 Movement Speed and her Basic Attacks shoot enhanced crossbow bolts, dealing 100 (+65% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target and nearby units. Jungle Heart also accumulates faster for the duration.

name: Bastion of Stone
description:
Grock gains a shield equal to 14% and empowers the next Basic Attack to deal 4 (+2% Total Physical Defense)% target's Physical Damage (capped at 300 (+20*Hero Level) against non-hero units). Cooldown: 18s - 12s (decreases with level). This cooldown is reduced by 200% when near terrain.
Grock's skills cannot be interrupted, and he gains 30 (+6*Hero Level)% extra while the shield is active.

name: Mighty Swing
description: Grock strikes forward with massive force, dealing 240 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Enemies with obstacles behind them are knocked back into the obstacle, knocked airborne, and take 4 (+2% Total Physical Defense)% extra Physical Damage (capped at 300 (+20*Hero Level) against non-hero units). If there are no obstacles behind, enemies are only knocked back slightly.

name: Earthen Rampart
description:
After a brief delay, Grock summons a stone wall in the target area, dealing 100 (+60% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and knocking enemies towards him.
Use Again: Cancel the wall early.

name: Tectonic Charge
description: Grock charges forward and gains Control Immunity, dealing 100 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in his path. Upon hitting terrain, he immediately stops and triggers a massive explosion that knocks nearby enemies airborne for 1s and deals 650 (+300% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. If this skill doesn't hit terrain, 50% of its cooldown is refunded.

name: Warmonger
description:
Malice Energy grants Argus an initial Crit Chance of 30%. Argus's Crits are converted into Demonic Slash, which ignores 30% of the target's , deals 90 (+25% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, and recovers 140 HP.

Demonic Slash cannot Crit, but can still trigger Crit-related effects.

name: Demonic Grip
description:
First Cast: Argus stretches out a demonic hand in the target direction, dealing 125 (+60% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hero or creep hit, stunning them for 0.7s. Both Argus and the target are pulled toward each other, then the target is slowed by 40% for 2s.
If no enemy is hit, Argus pulls himself toward the hand's destination instead.

Use Again: Argus dashes and performs a wide slash, dealing 175 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

name: Meteoric Sword
description:
After a short charge, Argus thrusts his Meteoric Sword in the target direction, dealing 120 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. If this hits an enemy hero, Argus briefly stuns them and gains 30% Attack Speed for 3s. Meteoric Sword's damage also gains a 40% boost to Crit Chance and Crit Damage.

Meteoric Sword counts as a Basic Attack and can trigger Attack Effects. Attack Speed shortens the charge time.

name: Eternal Evil
description:
Argus removes all control effects, gains Death Immunity for 4s, and deals 300 (+180% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies. This damage scales with Argus's lost HP, dealing up to 50% extra damage when his HP falls below 30%.
When Death Immunity ends, Argus recovers HP equal to all damage dealt to enemy heroes during its duration.

Passive: If Argus takes fatal damage while Eternal Evil is not on cooldown, he automatically enters Death Immunity.

name: Lakeshore Ambience
description:
For 8s after casting a skill, Odette's next Basic Attack gains extra range and bounces between enemies (or an enemy and herself), dealing 144-200 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage per hit.

Odette's skills also trigger this effect on hit (up to 3 stacks).

name: Avian Authority
description: Odette releases a magic swan in the target direction, dealing 300 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 2s.

name: Blue Nova
description: Odette releases magic energy balls in the target direction, dealing 250 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hit and immobilizing them for 1.5s. Upon hit, an energy ball splits off to attack a nearby enemy (prioritizes enemy heroes), dealing 250 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and immobilizing them for 1.5s.

name: Swan Song
description:
Odette channels a dance, gaining a 1200 (+150% Total Magic Power) shield and dealing up to 2000 (+750% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies in a large area for 5s. During this time, her Movement Speed is reduced by 40%, but she can move freely.

Use again to cancel. Only high-level control effects can interrupt this skill.

name: Soul Cutter
description: Each time Lancelot charges, his damage is increased by 7.5% for 4s, up to 30%.

name: Puncture
description:
Lancelot charges in the target direction, dealing 150 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way and applying a Sword Mark to the first unmarked enemy hit. The Sword Mark lasts 3s.

If Lancelot successfully applies a Sword Mark to an enemy, the skill's cooldown will be reset.

name: Thorned Rose
description: Lancelot strikes in the target direction 3 times, each time dealing 220 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit (damage is reduced when multiple enemies are hit). He's untargetable during this process. Enemies in the center of the area take all the 3 hits and are slowed by 20% for 0.5s. The slow effect can stack.

name: Phantom Execution
description: After a short delay, Lancelot performs an executioner's strike in the target direction, dealing 350 (+170% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit. He is invincible throughout the process.

name: Young Again
description: Upon death, Diggie reverses time and turns back to egg form, in which he can continue to move around and gains a new set of skills. He cannot be targeted in egg form and will revive after a period of time.

name: Auto Alarm Bomb
description:
Diggie flings an owl alarm to the target location that remains stationary for 25s or until it reacts to the first enemy in range, chasing them and exploding upon collision. The explosion deals 350 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slows them by 30%.

Diggie gains 2 stacks of Dangerous Sparks each time an enemy hero is hit by the explosion (up to 60 stacks), each stack increasing the skill's damage by 1%. He loses half the stacks upon death, but can gain 1 stack of Dangerous Sparks each time his skill hits an enemy hero when in egg form.

Up to 5 owl alarms can exist at the same time.

name: Reverse Time
description:
Diggie marks the target enemy hero for 4s and pulls them back to their previous location after the duration ends, dealing 150 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and briefly slowing them by 80%.

If the enemy moves out of the circle, the pull will be triggered early.

name: Time Journey
description: Diggie removes all debuffs on nearby allied heroes (including himself) and grants them a 650 (+300% Total Magic Power) shield and Control Immunity for 2s. He also gains 50% Movement Speed for 0.5s.

name: Thickened Blood
description:
Hylos gains 1 extra Max Mana for every 2.5 Extra gained.
When out of Mana, he can consume HP to cast skills.

name: Law and Order
description:
Hylos gains 50% Movement Speed and causes his next Basic Attack within 3s to deal 300 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the target, knocking back and stunning them for 1s.

The extra Movement Speed rapidly decays over the duration and vanishes after the next Basic Attack.

name: Ring of Punishment
description:
Hylos releases the Ring of Punishment, dealing 100 (+20% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies per second while slowing them by 4% and reducing their Attack Speed by 7.5% for 2.5s (up to 8 stacks). Each stack also increases the enemy's damage taken from the Ring of Punishment by 5%. The Ring of Punishment consumes 30 Mana per second when it's active.

Use Again: Hylos cancels the Ring of Punishment.

name: Glorious Pathway
description:
Hylos creates a huge pathway in the target direction, reducing enemies' Movement Speed by 75% for 1s. The pathway lasts 6s.
When on the pathway, Hylos gains Slow Immunity and recovers 3% per second. Allied heroes moving along the pathway gain 60% extra Movement Speed, while enemy heroes on the pathway will be slowed by 25%.

name: Decimation
description: Upon death, Zhask summons a frenzied Nightmaric Spawn on the spot, which gradually loses HP over time until death.

name: Nightmaric Spawn
description:
Zhask summons a Nightmaric Spawn that inherits 55% of his , , and . It automatically fires Death Ray at nearby enemies, dealing 55 (+ 20%) (+ 20% Extra Attack Speed) Magic Damage and slowing them by up to 30%. It disappears when Zhask moves too far away.

Death Ray is considered a Basic Attack but cannot Crit.

Fusion Enhanced: Nightmaric Spawn deals 180% damage and can be repositioned.

name: Mind Eater
description:
Zhask fires a penetrating psychic beam in the target direction, dealing 300 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Afterward, the Nightmaric Spawn attacks enemies hit by Mind Eater, dealing 120 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and stunning them for 0.5s.

Fusion Enhanced: Mind Eater damage is increased to 540 (+180% Total Magic Power).

name: Hive Clones
description:
Zhask releases a swarm of Hive Clones in the target direction. The clones explode upon hitting an enemy, dealing 55 (+18% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and reducing their Movement Speed by 80% for 1s.
If the Hive Clones hit no target, they burrow into the ground to ambush passing enemies.

Fusion Enhanced: Zhask releases several swarms of Hive Clones.
Subsequent damage to the same target decays to 20%.

name: Dominator's Descent
description:
Zhask selects a target area to summon an enhanced Nightmaric Spawn and fuses with it. Nightmaric Spawn can inherit 100% of his attributes and get extra attributes. His skills are enhanced during the fusion period.

Use Again: Zhask immediately gets off the Nightmaric Spawn and loses enhancement.

name: Shadow of Styx
description:
Helcurt remains in Prowler state until spotted by the enemy team, gaining 15% extra Movement Speed, and continuously regenerating (+30% Total Physical Attack) HP if he has not dealt any damage.
He gains 50% extra Attack Speed and 50% extra Movement Speed (decreasing over time) for 4s upon being spotted and leaves Prowler state 0.75s later.
Any hero killed after being hit by Helcurt leaves a dark fog that explodes and spreads with a cooldown of 10s. Helcurt Conceals himself while within the dark fog.

name: Hidden Terror
description:
Passive: When Helcurt is in the Prowler state, Terrify also affects enemy heroes hit and briefly reveals them. Its cooldown decreases 3 times as fast as normal.
Active: Helcurt blinks to the target location and deals 150 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area, reducing their Movement Speed by 60% for 0.75s.

name: Deadly Stinger
description:
Passive: Helcurt gains 1 Deadly Stinger for every 1.5s spent in Prowler state or on each Basic Attack. Up to 5 Deadly Stingers can be stored.

Active: Helcurt fires all Deadly Stingers forward, each dealing 180 (+50% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies (minions and creeps take only 70% of the damage).
Deadly Stinger counts as a Basic Attack but cannot Crit.

name: Dark Night Falls
description:
Helcurt summons the Dark Night, reducing all enemies' sight range and blocking ally vision sharing for 3s. During Dark Night, Helcurt gains 40% extra Movement Speed.

The Dark Night makes it easier for Helcurt to leave enemies' sight range.

name: Spiritual Unity
description: Every 5s to 8s (scales with Feathered Air Strike level), Verri enters the Hunting state. On Pharsa's next attack against an enemy hero, Verri deals extra Magic Damage equal to 8% of the target's (+ 1% per 200 ) and slows them by 60% for 1s.

name: Curse of Crow
description:
Pharsa unleashes a blast of magic at the target location, dealing 300 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and marking them for 4s.

When Pharsa hits a marked enemy with a Basic Attack or active skill, the mark is consumed, stunning them for 1s.

Marked enemies will have their positions revealed.

name: Energy Impact
description: Pharsa releases magic energy in the target direction, dealing 475 (+145% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit.

name: Feathered Air Strike
description:
Passive: Each level-up reduces Spiritual Unity's interval by 1s.
Active: Pharsa takes flight for 8s and bombards the target area, dealing 530 (+160% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies within. This skill can be cast up to 4 times during the flight.

name: Wings by Wings
description:
Pharsa turns into mist and wraps around Verri, gaining 150% extra Movement Speed (decays over time) and the ability to fly over terrain for 5s.

This state ends immediately when she is controlled or uses a Basic Attack or skill.

name: Lethal Shot
description:
If Lesley doesn't take damage for 5s, her next Basic Attack gains extra range and 50% Crit Chance and deals 100 (+100% Total Physical Attack) True Damage (20% extra damage against minions).
Each point of fixed Physical Penetration and each 1% Physical Penetration Lesley acquires is converted into 1% Crit Damage, but her base Crit Damage is reduced to 130%.
Lesley's Basic Attack restores 5 points of energy and her Lethal Shot doubles the amount of energy restored. The Lethal Shot effect will activate immediately after Lesley uses a skill.

name: Master of Camouflage
description:
Lesley enters the Camouflage state, gaining double Energy Regen, 40% extra Movement Speed, and 85 extra .
The state lasts 3s or until Lesley takes or deals damage. Enemies can detect Lesley's position through distortions of their surroundings.

name: Tactical Grenade
description:
Lesley throws a tactical grenade in the target direction while jumping back slightly, dealing 150 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area and knocking them back.

Lesley can cast this skill during Ultimate Snipe to cancel the state and immediately fire a Fatal Bullet at the target. The attack is only triggered when there are unfired Fatal Bullets left.

name: Ultimate Snipe
description:
Passive: Lesley's Crit Chance is increased by 10%.
Active: Lesley locks onto an enemy hero and fires 4 Fatal Bullets in succession. Each bullet deals 250 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) (+ 5% of the target's lost ) Physical Damage and restores 10 Energy on hit. Bullets can be blocked by other enemy heroes.

If this skill is interrupted, each remaining bullet reduces this skill's cooldown by 10%.

name: Mecha Suppression
description: Each time Jawhead deals damage to an enemy hero or a Creep, he inflicts a stack of Mecha Suppression on them for 3s (up to 6 stacks). Each stack of Mecha Suppression increases all damage dealt to the target by 2% (limited to 50% for Creeps).

name: Smart Missiles
description: Jawhead launches up to 12 missiles at random nearby enemies over 5s, each missile dealing 135 (+30% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the enemy hit.

name: Ejector
description:
Jawhead gains 30% Movement Speed and a 500 (+100% Total Physical Attack) shield for 5s.

Use Again: Jawhead flings the nearest unit (prioritizes heroes) to the target location, dealing 300 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and stunning them for 0.5s. Can be used on allied heroes and they will not take damage.

name: Unstoppable Force
description: Jawhead charges into the target enemy hero, dealing 350 (+150% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and briefly stunning them. Enemies around the target are knocked back and dealt the same amount of damage. Jawhead is immune to control effects during the charge.

name: Smart Heart
description: Angela gains 5% extra Movement Speed for 4s each time she casts a skill (up to 20%). When she's attached to an allied hero, the Movement Speed boost is transferred to the allied hero.

name: Love Waves
description:
Angela sends Love Waves in the target direction, dealing 170 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit, revealing their positions briefly, and applying a stack of Lover's Mark (up to 5 stacks). Each stack of Lover's Mark increases the damage by 20% and slows enemies hit by 8% for 3s.
Love Waves also restore 150 (+75% Total Magic Power) HP to allied heroes hit. Angela can store up to 5 charges of this skill, and the charge time is affected by Cooldown Reduction.
When attached to allies, this skill's cooldown is reduced by 50%.

name: Puppet-on-a-String
description:
Angela launches a Puppet String at the target enemy (excluding minions), dealing 300 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and gradually slowing them by up to 80%. If the enemy is still connected to the string after 3s, they'll be immobilized for 1.5s and take 450 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.

Each stack of Lover's Mark increases the final damage by 20%.

name: Heartguard
description:
Angela begins channeling, applying a 600 (+150% Total Magic Power) shield to the target allied hero regardless of distance. Once attached to an ally, the shield remains until detached. After the channeling is complete, she attaches herself to the allied hero for 20s, during which she can cast skills at zero Mana cost.
Angela can cast this skill again to cancel the channeling or detach herself from the allied hero. The attaching state will end early if the allied hero is killed.

name: Dagger Specialist
description: Each skill cast adds a rune to Gusion's dagger (stacks up to 4 times). Each stack enhances Gusion's next Basic Attack to deal additional damage equal to 3% of the target's and recover 50 (+25% Total Magic Power) HP for himself.

name: Sword Spike
description:
Gusion throws a dagger in the target direction, dealing 200 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hit and marking them.

Use Again: Gusion moves behind the marked enemy, dealing 200 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to them. This skill cannot be interrupted while Gusion is moving behind the marked enemy.

name: Shadowblade Slaughter
description:
Gusion throws a volley of daggers in the target direction, each dealing 100 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 6% for 2s (when hit by multiple daggers, the slow effect can stack up to 30%).

Use Again: Gusion recalls the daggers, each dealing 65 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in its path.

name: Incandescence
description:
Gusion dashes to the target location, resetting the cooldowns of Sword Spike and Shadowblade Slaughter. If Shadowblade Slaughter was cast once before the reset, Gusion can throw another five daggers on his next Shadowblade Slaughter cast, and recall a total of ten daggers afterward.

Use Again: Gusion dashes a short distance in the target direction.

name: Ashing
description:
Valir's skills apply a stack of Ablaze to enemies hit, dealing them Magic Damage equal to 1 (+0.2% Total Magic Power)% of their per second for 3s.

At 3 stacks, the fire detonates, dealing Magic Damage equal to 5 (+1% Total Magic Power)% of the target's and stunning them for 1s.
A target can only be stunned by Valir's skills once every 7s.

name: Burst Fireball
description:
Valir launches a fireball that explodes upon hitting the first target, dealing 235 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing them by 30% for 1s. The flame on the ground explodes after 1s, dealing 118 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.

Valir recharges 1 fireball every 9s (up to 2 charges). Hitting an enemy hero or legend creep with this skill immediately restores 1 charge, while hitting a minion restores 4s of the recharge time.

Vengeance Flame: Increases the cast range of Burst Fireball by 30%.

name: Searing Torrent
description:
Valir unleashes a torrent of flames in the target direction, dealing 200 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and knocking them back to the end of its path.

Vengeance Flame: The torrent forms a firewall at the end of its path that lasts 4s, dealing 100 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies every 1s.

Enemies hit by the torrent or the firewall are slowed by 25% for 1s.

name: Vengeance Flame
description: Valir removes all debuffs on himself and gains 40% Movement Speed that decays over 3s. Meanwhile, he conjures 4 Vengeance Flames that enhance Burst Fireball and Searing Torrent for 9s.

name: Asura's Wrath
description: Each time Martis uses a skill, his Attack Speed will be increased by 30%, 120% maximum. Lasts 4s. He gains (+8*Hero Level) extra Attack at full stacks.

name: Asura Aura
description: Martis draws enemies to a fan-shaped area in front of him and deals 350 (+130% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage, slowing them by 40% for 2s.

name: Mortal Coil
description:
Martis strikes in the target direction three times, each time dealing 225 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit. Enemies hit by the first and third strike are also knocked back. The attack direction can be changed once using the Joystick.

Use Again: Martis leaps in the target direction, dealing 300 (+150% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in his path and knocking them airborne.
Martis gains Control Immunity and 60% Damage Reduction when casting this skill.

name: Decimation
description:
Martis lunges at a designated enemy hero, dealing 700 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage (deals True Damage if the enemy's HP is below 50%).
If the enemy is killed by this skill, Martis can cast the skill again within 10s and gains 100% extra Movement Speed that gradually decays over 5s. Each successive cast also increases the skill's damage by 15% (up to 30%).

name: Radiance
description:
Each time Uranus takes damage, he gains a stack of Radiance. Each stack recovers 1.2-11.2 HP (increases with level) every 0.8s for 10s, up to 20 stacks.
Uranus's Basic Attacks deal (+80% Total Physical Attack) (+ 4-8 × Radiance stacks) Magic Damage (increases with level).

name: Ionic Edge
description:
Uranus releases 2 energy blades that orbit around him, dealing 155 (+30% Total Magic Power) (+6 × Radiance stacks) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 2s.
Each blade can only damage the same target once.
