name: Transcendent Ward
description:
Uranus charges to the target location, dealing 80 (+20% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies along the way, and 160 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies at the target location and slowing them by 25%. Uranus also generates a 300 (+200% Total Magic Power) shield for 4s.

The shield explodes at the end of its duration or when destroyed, dealing 300 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies nearby.

name: Consecration
description:
Uranus unleashes the energy stored within his body, removing slow effects on himself, recovering 200 HP, and gaining 60% Movement Speed for 8s (decays over time).

Uranus directly gains 5 stacks of Radiance, increasing shields received and HP Regen by 20% for 8s.

name: Ninjutsu: Petal Barrage
description:
Hanabi's Basic Attacks and skills launch Petal Blades upon hitting a target, dealing 30% damage and bouncing up to 4 times to nearby enemies. Petal Blades launched by Basic Attacks inherit Attack Effects.
If bounces from the same Basic Attack or skill hit the same target multiple times, subsequent bounces deal 30% less damage.

name: Ninjutsu: Equinox
description:
Passive: Whenever Hanabi has a shield from any source, she is immune to control effects.
Active: Hanabi gains a 300 (+40% Total Physical Attack) shield for 5s. When the shield is active, she gains 20% Movement Speed and 25% Attack Speed, and 20% of her damage dealt to enemy heroes is added to this shield (only 10% of the damage dealt to non-hero units is added). This shield cannot exceed 50% of her .

name: Ninjutsu: Soul Scroll
description: Hanabi fires the energy Kunai in the targeted direction, dealing 350 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way and reducing their Movement Speed by 60% for 1s. Enemy units hit will also be marked, allowing Hanabi's next Bounce Damage from Basic Attacks to deal 30 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage on them with no damage decay.

name: Forbidden Jutsu: Higanbana
description: Hanabi throws Higanbana in the targeted direction, dealing 300 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hero hit and immobilizing them for 0.8s. After 1s, Higanbana will bloom at the location of the first hit, dealing 300 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies. Subsequent hits on the same target decay to 30% damage.

name: Trouble Maker
description: Each time Chang'e deals damage to an enemy, she leaves a mark on them that reduces their Movement Speed by 1% (up to 20%).

name: Starmoon Shockwave
description:
Chang'e sends an energy sphere in the target direction, dealing 350 (+130% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in its path and slowing them by 10% for 1.5s.

Crescent Moon: The Crescent Moon sends 4 extra energy spheres along with Chang'e's, each dealing 20% damage and slowing enemies hit. The slow effect can stack (up to 20%).

name: Crescent Moon
description:
Chang'e summons the Crescent Moon, gaining a permanent 300 (+150% Total Magic Power) shield and 10% Movement Speed until the shield is broken. Each time she casts a skill, she gains an extra 50% Movement Speed that decays over 2.5s.
Crescent Moon: Enhances her Basic Attacks to deal 20 (+35% Total Magic Power) extra Magic Damage 2 times.

Each time Chang'e deals Magic Damage with her Basic Attacks or skills, this skill's cooldown is reduced by 0.2s.

name: Meteor Shower
description:
Chang'e gains 10% Movement Speed for 4s. During this time, she fires 30 meteors in the target direction, each dealing 60 (+21% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hit. This skill deals 100% extra damage to minions and creeps.

Crescent Moon: Fires meteors alongside Chang'e, each dealing 33% damage.

name: Wings of Lightning
description: Kaja's skill damage applies the Paralysis effect to enemy units, briefly slowing heroes or summoned units and reducing their damage by 8% for 5s.

name: Ring of Order
description:
Kaja summons a ring of Primal Lightning that expands and returns to him.
Enemies hit take 160 (+70% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and recover 78 (+45% Total Magic Power) HP to Kaja. Healing from subsequent hits is reduced to 33%.

name: Soaring Wings
description:
Kaja dashes to the target area, gaining Control Immunity during the dash. On arrival, he deals 250 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, knocking back and stunning nearby enemies for 0.5s, then enters the Soaring state.

The Soaring state lasts 6.6s. During this time, he ignores obstacles and gains 15% Movement Speed, but his turn radius is restricted. He can use Basic Attacks while moving, dealing 100 (+25% Total Magic Power) (+ 2% target's ) Magic Damage to surrounding enemies.

Upon entering the Soaring state, the cooldown of Soaring Wings is reduced to 4s (unaffected by Cooldown Reduction). Hitting a hero or creep extends the Soaring state by 2.6s.

name: Divine Binding
description:
Kaja hurls a Primal Lightning Lasso at the target area. After a 0.5s delay, all enemy heroes remaining in the area take 360 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and are trapped for 2.5s.

While active, Kaja can drag the lasso, shrinking its radius and pulling enemies at the boundary along with him (does not interrupt their skills).

name: Symbiosis
description:
Selena can switch freely between her two forms.
Elven Form: Selena applies Abyssal Mark when her skills deal damage. Marks last 8s and can stack up to 2 times.
Abyssal Form: Selena's Basic Attacks become melee and deal (+25% Total Magic Power) additional Magic Damage. Her skills deal 240-450 (+40% Total Magic Power) additional Magic Damage to enemies with Abyssal Mark and consume their mark stacks by 1. This damage is increased to 250% against Creeps and Minions.

name: Abyssal Trap
description:
Selena summons an Abyssal Devil to lurk underground. The Abyssal Devil will attach itself to any enemy that approaches, inflicting a stack of Abyssal Mark and reducing their Movement Speed by 50% for 1s. The Abyssal Devil then explodes, dealing 350 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the area and reducing their Movement Speed by 50% for 1s.

Each additional Abyssal Devil on an enemy increases the final damage by 50%.

Each Abyssal Devil can lurk up to 60s and up to 3 Abyssal Devils can exist at the same time.

name: Abyssal Arrow
description:
Selena fires an abyssal wraith in the target direction that stops when it hits an enemy hero, Creep, or Summon, dealing 250 (+20% Total Magic Power) to 500 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the target hit and stunning them for 0.5s to 2.5s while revealing their locations (the damage and stun duration increase with the wraith's travel distance).

The wraith will pick up Abyssal Trap as it travels over it and will apply the trap to the enemy target upon stunning them.

If the wraith stuns an enemy for 0.9s or longer, Selena will gain 60% Movement Speed for 2s.

name: Primal Darkness
description:
Passive: Selena gains 5 .
Active: Selena enters Abyssal Form and gains 20% Movement Speed for 0.8s. This also immediately resets the cooldown of Soul Eater and Garotte.

name: Soul Eater
description:
Selena strengthens her claws with the power of the Abyss, causing the next Basic Attack to dash to a target and deal an additional 200 (+130% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage while granting her a 300 (+150% Total Magic Power) shield.

If this damage detonates an Abyssal Mark, Garotte's cooldown will reset.

name: Garotte
description:
Selena charges in the target direction, dealing 150 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in her path.

If this skill's damage detonates an Abyssal Mark, its cooldown will reset.

name: Blessing of the Moon Goddess
description:
Passive: Selena gains 5 .
Active: Selena enters Elven Form and gains 20% Movement Speed for 0.8s. This also immediately resets the cooldown of Abyssal Trap and Abyssal Arrow.

name: Contract: Transform
description: Every 8s, Aldous gains a shield equal to 350 (+ 3 per Soul Steal stack) for 3s on his next Basic Attack. He also gains 60% Movement Speed for 1s.

name: Contract: Soul Steal
description:
Aldous enhances his next Basic Attack to deal 200 (+100% Total Physical Attack) (+ 3 per Soul Steal stack) Physical Damage.

Killing a siege minion with this attack grants 12 Soul Steal stacks; killing any other non-hero unit grants 5 stacks. Hitting an enemy hero grants an extra 5 stack(s), while killing one grants 12 (up to 1000 stacks).

This attack deals 300% extra Base Damage to minions and creeps. Aldous also gains 6 stack(s) when allied units eliminate a nearby enemy siege minion, and 2 stack(s) when they eliminate any other nearby non-hero unit.

Aldous gains 20% Movement Speed while moving toward enemy heroes during this skill.

name: Contract: Explosion
description:
Aldous assumes a defensive stance, gaining 30% Damage Reduction for 2s or until canceled.
He then deals 200 (+20% Total Physical Attack)-400 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and stuns them for 0.5-1s (scales with defensive stance duration).

name: Contract: Chase Fate
description:
Aldous gains vision of all enemy heroes for 5s.
Use Again: During this time, he dashes toward an enemy hero, dealing 250 (+ 8% target's ) Physical Damage and knocking the target back for 1s.
Aldous can interrupt the target's Recall while dashing.

name: Battle Side-by-side
description: Dexter assists Claude on each of his Basic Attacks, dealing 25 (+25% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the same target (inherits a portion of Attack Effects).

name: Art of Thievery
description:
Claude emits a disruption wave in the target direction, dealing 250 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area, reducing their Movement Speed by 20% and Attack Speed by 10%.
For each enemy hit, he gains 4% Movement and Attack Speed (doubled if hitting enemy heroes) for 6s (up to 5 stacks).

name: Battle Mirror Image
description:
Claude conjures a mirror image of Dexter at the target location that automatically attacks nearby enemies for 5.5s. The mirror image's Basic Attacks deal 25 (+25% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and trigger Claude's Attack Effects.
Use Again: Claude switches places with the mirror image.

name: Blazing Duet
description: Claude and Dexter rapidly fire at nearby enemies for 3s, dealing 40 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to up to two enemies with each shot (counts as Basic Attack Damage). Claude also gains a 20 (+3% Total Physical Attack) shield each time the Ultimate deals damage to an enemy.

name: Windtalk
description: Vale gains 1 stack of Windtalk each time he gets a kill or an assist that increases his Movement Speed by 8. This effect can stack up to 10 times.

name: Wind Blade
description: Vale unleashes two wind blades toward the left and right of a target area, each dealing 250 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit.

name: Windblow
description: Vale sends a whirlwind in the target direction, dealing 350 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and knocking them airborne for 0.8s (each enemy can only be knocked airborne 1 time). When the whirlwind reaches its destination, it will remain for 1.6s while continuously dealing a total of 150 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in range.

name: Windstorm
description:
Vale summons a windstorm at the target location, dealing a total of 150 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the area and slowing them by 20% while continuously pulling them into its center. After 1s, the windstorm will explode, dealing 900 (+240% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.

The remaining whirlwinds will also be pulled into the center.

name: The Oath Keeper
description:
Leomord's Basic Attacks and skills grant him 25 Oath Keeper energy each time they deal damage to targets. When the energy reaches 100, his next Basic Attack deals 200% Crit Damage and restores 100 (+10*Hero Level) (+15% Extra Max HP) HP.
Leomord's Basic Attacks cannot normally Crit, and every 1% Crit Chance is converted into 1% Crit Damage.
Mounted State: Each Oath Keeper energy gain is increased by 200%.

name: Momentum
description:
Leomord begins channeling, slowing enemies in the target direction by 25%. When the channeling is complete or interrupted, he thrusts his sword in the same direction, dealing up to 500 (+180% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit (scales with channeling time; increased to 140% against creeps except the Turtle and Lord) and slowing them by 40% for 1s.

Use Again: Cast the skill again to cancel the channeling and immediately perform the thrust.

name: Decimation Assault
description: Leomord charges in a designated direction, dealing 300 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way and slowing them by 30% for 1s.

name: Phantom Steed
description:
Leomord summons Barbiel to rush to him, knocking back and dealing 100 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in its path.
If Barbiel comes in contact with Leomord, they will enter the Mounted State, gaining 50% Movement Speed that decays over 2s.
Mounted State: Leomord gains a brand-new set of skills, and his Basic Attack can be used while moving and hits a circular area to deal AOE damage. Leomord also gains 70 Movement Speed and 30 . This lasts 10s.

name: Phantom Stomp
description: Barbiel leaps forward, dealing 325 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the landing area and in front of him, while slowing them by 40% for 1s.

name: Phantom Charge
description: Barbiel charges forward in a designated direction, and knocks back all enemies on the path, dealing 300 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

name: Dreamland Twist
description:
Lunox is twisted by the powers of Chaos and Order.
When she uses the Power of Order, she gains 0.5% Spell Vamp for every 1% Magic Penetration.
When she uses the Power of Chaos, she gains 0.5% Magic Penetration for every 1% Spell Vamp.

name: Starlight Pulse
description:
Lunox summons a rain of starlight upon nearby enemies, dealing 200 (+110% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. The starlight then returns to Lunox, each recovering 75 (+30% Total Magic Power) HP to her (doubled when hitting enemy heroes).

This skill shares a cooldown with Chaos Assault. It grants Power of Order and ends the Power of Chaos state.

name: Chaos Assault
description:
Lunox unleashes Chaos Energy at a target enemy, dealing 250 (+120% Total Magic Power) (+ 2.5% target's ) Magic Damage (+ 1.5% against creeps).

This skill shares its cooldown with Starlight Pulse. Using it grants Power of Chaos and ends the Power of Order state.

name: Cosmic Fission
description: Lunox channels the power of Order and Chaos in the target direction, dealing 300 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in its path and slowing them by 40% for 2s.

name: Order & Chaos
description:
Lunox is twisted by the powers of Chaos and Order.

When Power of Order is dominant, she can cast Brilliance to become invincible and deal continuous damage to nearby enemies.
When Power of Chaos is dominant, she can cast Darkening to blink in a target direction and greatly reduce the cooldown of Chaos Assault for a brief period.

name: Chaos Assault
description:
Lunox unleashes Chaos Energy at a target enemy, dealing 250 (+120% Total Magic Power) (+ 2.5% target's ) Magic Damage (+ 1.5% against creeps).

While enhanced by Power of Chaos, this skill has a brief cooldown, and its cast interval is unaffected by Cooldown Reduction.

name: Power of Order: Brilliance
description: Lunox creates a Light Barrier, becoming invincible and untargetable for 2.5s, and gaining 30% Movement Speed. The barrier moves with her, dealing 100 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies every 0.5s.

name: Power of Chaos: Darkening
description:
Lunox blinks in the target direction, dealing 250 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 30% for 4s.

For the next 4s, Lunox enhances her Power of Chaos, greatly reducing the cooldown of Chaos Assault (unaffected by Cooldown Reduction). Using Starlight Pulse ends this enhanced state.

name: Ame no Habakiri
description: Damage dealt by Hanzo's Basic Attacks and skills inflicts a stack of Dark Ninjutsu on the target, up to 5 stacks. Ninjutsu: Demon Feast can only be cast on targets with full stacks of Dark Ninjutsu.

name: Ninjutsu: Demon Feast
description:
The skill can only be used on targets with max stacks of Dark Ninjutsu. When targeting a creep, Hanzo will immediately devour it and digest it over a period of time to recover 20% HP.
When targeting the Turtle, Lord, or enemy heroes, he deals 600 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage, recovers 150 (+80% Total Physical Attack) HP, and reduces this skill's cooldown by 60%.

name: Ninjutsu: Dark Mist
description:
Hanzo dashes in the target direction, leaving dark mist in front that deals 90 (+45% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area every 0.5s, up to 5 times (this damage counts as Basic Attack damage but cannot Crit).
The dark mist slows enemies in the area by 40% and grants Hanzo 20% Movement Speed.

name: Kinjutsu: Pinnacle Ninja
description:
Hanzo charges into battle as Hanekage, consuming 170 Energy per second. He gains 20 Energy when a non-hero unit dies nearby and 200 Energy when it's a hero. He gains 15 Energy when attacking a hero, and 45 Energy when attacking the Turtle or the Lord. When Energy runs out, Hanzo's body will be slowly drawn to Hanekage's position.

While in Hanekage form, Hanzo's body is invincible, while Hanekage ignores obstacles and gains 50% Movement Speed and 30% Attack Speed.

Use Again or Upon Death: Hanekage returns to Hanzo's body, recovering 360 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) HP and becoming untargetable during the return. If Hanekage is killed, Hanzo will be slowed by 50% and revealed for 6s, and the skill's cooldown will be doubled.

name: Forbidden Ninjutsu: Soul Snatch
description:
Hanekage dashes to an enemy hero, dealing 300 (+60% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage after a brief delay. Each stack of Dark Ninjutsu on the target increases this damage by 20%. At max Dark Ninjutsu stacks, he deals 12 (+3% Extra Physical Attack)% target's extra damage (ignores 30% of target's ) and recovers 150 (+80% Total Physical Attack) HP.
This skill can be cast on the Turtle or Lord (deals up to 1000 damage).

name: Forbidden Ninjutsu: Black Mist
description:
Hanekage dashes in the target direction, knocking enemies in his path airborne for 0.4s and dealing 405 (+45% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage (recovers 200 Energy if hitting an enemy hero), leaving a Dark Mist in the area he passes through.
The mist deals 135 (+45% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area every 0.5s (up to 4 times). It also slows enemies in the area by 40%.

This damage is considered Basic Attack Damage, but cannot Crit.

name: Ninjutsu Flee: Return
description: Hanekage returns to Hanzo's body and exits the Hanekage form.

name: Deadly Thorns
description:
Whenever Belerick takes 50 or more damage, he has a 25% chance to shoot the nearest enemy unit, dealing 55 (+5*Hero Level) (+ 1.8% of his ) Magic Damage (scales with level). This attack can be triggered once every 0.4s.

His HP obtained from equipment and emblems is increased by 30%.

name: Ancient Seed
description:
Belerick releases vines in a designated direction, dealing 200 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies along the path and slowing them by 25%. Ancient Seeds left by the vines will erupt into thorns after 0.8s, dealing 200 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies on the path and taunting them for 1.2s.

Deals 80% extra damage against Minions.

name: Nature's Strike
description:
Belerick gains 80% Movement Speed (decays over 2s) and enhances his next Basic Attack.

The enhanced Basic Attack deals 300 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slows the target by 60% for 1.4s. Belerick also recovers HP equal to 240 + 10% of his .

Each time Deadly Thorns is triggered, this skill's cooldown is reduced by 1s.

name: Wrath of Dryad
description: Belerick conjures spreading vines around him, dealing 100 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the area 4 times, taunting and slowing them for 1.5s.

name: Aerial Dominance
description:
Kimmy can move and aim in different directions while using her Spray Gun, but she cannot lock onto a specific target. Each Chemical Bolt deals (+18% Total Physical Attack) (+24% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Hitting enemy heroes or non-hero units restores 6 / 3 Starlium, respectively. At max Starlium, she continuously consumes it to enhance her Basic Attacks, making them deal (+22.5% Total Physical Attack) (+30% Total Magic Power) damage and pierce targets (enhanced Basic Attacks only benefit from 50% Spell Vamp).
Kimmy can keep moving while shooting and does not benefit from Attack Speed Bonus. Every 1% Attack Speed gained is converted to 1 .
Kimmy's Basic Attacks only deal 60% damage to Turrets.

name: Anti-Grav Thruster
description:
Kimmy uses her jetpack to take flight, removing and becoming immune to slow effects. She can pass through terrain and gains 120% extra Movement Speed that decays over 1s. During the flight, she continuously fires 4 Chemical Bolts at nearby enemies, each dealing 20 (+25% Total Physical Attack) (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing them by 50% for 0.5s.
Kimmy does not consume Starlium during flight.

name: Starlium Beam
description:
Kimmy fires a Starlium Beam in the target direction, immobilizing enemies in its path and dealing 300 (+50% Total Physical Attack) (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage for 1s.
Each enemy hero hit grants 20 Starlium.

name: Traction Pulse
description:
Kimmy charges up and fires a Traction Pulse in the target direction. Upon hitting an enemy or reaching its max range, it explodes, dealing 150 (+45% Total Physical Attack) (+54% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and creating a force field that slows enemies within by 50%.

After 1s, the field contracts, pulling enemy heroes within it to its center and dealing 15% of their current as Magic Damage. It also slows them by 50% for 2s. Each enemy hero hit grants Kimmy 40 Starlium.

name: Grand Lord Lava
description:
Thamuz's Basic Attacks have a chance of 10%–60% (scaling with Lava's Rage) to conjure Lava Energy beneath the target that erupts after a brief delay, dealing 55 (+60% Total Physical Attack)(+8*Hero Level) True Damage. Basic Attacks that don't trigger Lava Energy increase Thamuz's Lava's Rage.

While Thamuz is without his Scythes, he gains 25% Movement Speed. After retrieving his Scythes, his next Basic Attack slows the target by 30% and is guaranteed to trigger Lava Energy.

name: Molten Scythes
description:
Thamuz tosses Scythes in the target direction. After traveling a set distance or hitting the first enemy hero, they deal 120 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. The Scythes will then slow nearby enemies by 30% and deal 45 (+20% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage every 0.5s.

After leaving Thamuz for a short time or reaching a set distance, the Scythes return to him, dragging enemies along their path toward Thamuz. Thamuz can move toward the Scythes or cast the skill again to retrieve them.

name: Chasm Trample
description:
Thamuz jumps to a designated area to deal 230 (+60% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slow the enemy units by 25% for 2s upon landing.
If the Scythes are still travelling, they will return to Thamuz and Molten Scythes will reset its CD instantly.

name: Cauterant Inferno
description:
Thamuz spouts the lava within, dealing 300 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and creating a Cauterant Zone around himself. The Cauterant Zone lasts 9s and deals 30 (+10% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage every 0.5s to enemies in the area.

Meanwhile, Thamuz gains 800 (+50% Extra Max HP) , immediately healing for the same amount, and gains 60% Attack Speed. Each time his Basic Attacks or Scythes deal damage, he recovers 1.5% Max HP.

name: Key Insight
description: Harith gains insight from his Key. He gains 7% Hybrid Lifesteal for each nearby enemy hero, stacking up to 35%.

name: Synchro Fission
description:
Harith creates a phantom of himself in a distant location. Harith and his phantom then release Synchro Fission toward each other, dealing 150 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemy units on the path.

When the 2 energy waves collide, they explode, dealing 450 (+180% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies in the area.
This skill deals 60% extra damage to creeps (up to 1500 damage).

name: Chrono Dash
description:
Harith dashes towards the target direction, gaining a 120 (+120% Total Magic Power) shield that stacks up to 3 times and enhancing his next Basic Attack. His enhanced Basic Attack deals 200 (+100% Total Physical Attack)(+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slows enemies by 40%. Hitting an enemy reduces the cooldown of Chrono Dash by 3s.

The enhanced Basic Attack only deals 50 (+100% Total Physical Attack)(+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to Turrets.

name: Zaman Force
description:
Harith uses his Key to summon the Zaman Force, creating a multidimensional rift. Upon appearing, it reduces the cooldown of Chrono Dash by 4s. The rift continuously slows enemy heroes in the area by 40%.

When Harith comes into contact with the rift using Chrono Dash, he absorbs its energy, reducing the cooldown of Synchro Fission by 1s and Chrono Dash by 3s. Harith gains 15% Resilience while on the rift.

name: Mark of the King
description: Minsitthar's Basic Attacks and skills apply a stack of Mark of the King, up to 5 stacks. Upon reaching max stacks, the next attack detonates all Mark of the King stacks, dealing Physical Damage equal to 400 (+6% Max HP) of Minsitthar's Max HP and stunning the target for 0.8s while healing Minsitthar for 400 (+6% Max HP) HP. Can only trigger once every 6s on the same target.

name: Spear of Glory
description:
Minsitthar thrusts the Spear of Glory forward, dealing 175 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing enemies hit by 30%. Enemy heroes hit by the spear tip are stunned for 0.3s.

After a short delay, Minsitthar pulls the spear back, dealing 175 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in its path and pulling enemy heroes toward him. Pulled heroes are stunned for up to 0.8s based on the distance pulled.

name: Shield Assault
description: Minsitthar awakens the power in his shield and releases it, dealing 100 (+45% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in a rectangular area and slowing them by 80% (decaying rapidly over 2s). Meanwhile, he enters Phalanx state for 3s, reducing damage taken from the front by 25% and enhancing his Basic Attack to swiftly strike an area in front of him for 100 (+45% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage per hit.

name: King's Calling
description:
Minsitthar charges forward and calls 4 Royal Guards to form a field around him. The Royal Guards cannot move but will attack enemies in the field and deal (+30% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to them.
Enemies in the field are slowed by 30% and cannot use movement skills.

name: Thalassophobia
description:
Kadita gains the Blessing of the Ocean every 30s. Taking damage from an enemy hero activates the Blessing for 4s.

When the Blessing ends, she recovers 65% of the HP lost during this period (damage from minions and creeps does not activate this effect).

While in the River, Kadita gains 10% extra Movement Speed.

name: Ocean Ode
description:
Kadita summons an ocean wave to carry herself in the target direction and back, dealing 250 (+90% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30%. While inside the wave, she gains Control Immunity and 50% Damage Reduction. This skill can pass through obstacles and terrain.

Use Again: Kadita exits the wave without interrupting the wave's movement.

name: Breath of the Ocean
description:
After a short delay, Kadita summons an ocean wave to erupt at the target location, dealing 350 (+140% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and knocking them airborne for 1s.

Kadita can cast this skill during Ocean Ode to summon an ocean wave beneath her with a shorter eruption delay.

name: Rough Waves
description:
Kadita dives into the ground and sends ocean waves in all directions, each dealing 270 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30%. Enemies hit by multiple waves take increased damage. After a delay, the waves return to Kadita, each dealing 180 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit.

While underground, Kadita becomes untargetable and gains 60% Movement Speed.
This skill can only be interrupted by Suppression.

name: Vicious Retrieval
description:
When Faramis's skills deal damage to enemy heroes and summoned units, they leave behind Soul Fragments. Absorbing a Soul Fragment recovers 100 (+50% Total Magic Power) HP and grants 2 (up to 40 stacks).
Upon death, he consumes the absorbed Soul Fragments to reduce the respawn timer, each reducing the timer by 3% (up to 90%).
He can gain up to 1 Soul Fragment from the same enemy hero using skills every 4s. Enemies that die around Faramis also have a chance to drop Soul Fragments.

name: Shadow Stampede
description:
Faramis enters the Shadow state for 3s, gaining 70% Movement Speed, 25 , and 20% Cooldown Reduction of this skill. He also gains the ability to move through terrain. Enemy heroes he touches take 250 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and are marked with a Nether Mark. Upon leaving the Shadow state, Faramis pulls all the marked enemy heroes toward him, dealing 250 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.
Use Again: Ends the Shadow state early to pull marked enemy heroes toward him.
Soul Fragment absorption range is increased while this skill is active.

name: Ghost Bursters
description: Faramis gathers Nether energy in a fan-shaped area ahead, dealing 330 (+144% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies within. The energy will then split and bounce to nearby enemies, dealing 200 (+86% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage (splits up to 2 time(s) on enemy hero hits and 1 time(s) on non-enemy hero hits).

name: Nether Realm
description: Faramis turns his surroundings into the Nether Realm for 6s. Allied heroes within (including himself) enter the Specter state, gaining 400 (+ 10 (+5% Total Magic Power)%) extra HP and 50% extra Movement Speed for 1s. When the Specter state breaks, heroes within clear all debuffs and enter a brief Resurrection state for 1.3s. The Specter state immediately ends if the allied hero leaves the Nether Realm.

name: Chivalry Fist
description:
Every time Badang's Basic Attack hits a target, he gains a stack of Chivalry Fist. After gaining 4 stacks, his next Basic Attack deals 50 (+30% Total Physical Attack) extra Physical Damage to enemies hit and knocks them back. Enemies that are knocked into obstacles will be stunned for 0.6s (Minions and Creeps are stunned directly).
Fist Wind generated by Badang's skills will trigger this effect directly, and Fist Wind from his Ultimate increases the stun duration to 1s.

name: Fist Wind
description:
Badang unleashes a gust of Fist Wind in the target direction, dealing 125 (+90% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit, slowing them by 30% for 1.5s, and knocking them back. The Fist Wind will explode upon hitting an obstacle, dealing 100 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies. Fist Wind can trigger attack effects and grants Badang 1 Chivalry Fist stack upon cast.
Badang stores up to 2 Fist Wind charges and restores 1 charge every 10.4s.

name: Fist Break
description:
Badang dashes in the target direction, dealing 230 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in his path while gaining a 350 (+150% Total Physical Attack) shield that lasts 5s. He stops immediately upon hitting an enemy hero, slightly knocking them back while creating an obstacle that lasts 4s behind them. Enemies hit by the obstacle are dealt 130 (+30% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

Use Again: Badang removes the obstacle he created.

name: Fist Crack
description:
Badang throws a flurry of punches in the target direction, dealing 60 (+54% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit multiple times (can trigger attack effects). The Fist Wind generated by the punches will explode upon hitting an obstacle, dealing 30 (+27% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies.
Badang is immune to control effects for the duration.

name: Spell Curse
description:
Khufra activates the Spell Curse left by Esmeralda every 8s, enhancing his next Basic Attack. The enhanced Basic Attack gains extra attack range and deals 100 (+120% Total Physical Attack) (+ 6% target's ) Magic Damage. He also slows the target by 30% for 1.5s and recovers 8% of his on hit.

Each time Khufra applies a control effect to an enemy hero with his skill, the cooldown of Spell Curse is reduced by 4s.

name: Tyrant's Revenge
description: Khufra pulls the bandages on his arms to launch himself in the specified direction, dealing 50 (+ 7 (+1.5% Extra Physical Attack)% of his ) Physical Damage to all enemies on the path. When blinking to the furthest distance or encountering the first enemy hero, Khufra will immediately stop, dealing 50 (+ 7 (+1.5% Extra Physical Attack)% of his ) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and knocking them airborne for up to 1s.

name: Bouncing Ball
description:
Khufra uses bandages to wrap himself into a Bouncing Ball, increasing his by 30%. Enemies trying to use mobility skills to move across Khufra will be knocked airborne.

Each time the Bouncing Ball hits the ground, it deals 50 (+ 3 (+2% Extra Physical Attack)% of his ) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and slows them by 80% for 0.2s.

name: Tyrant's Rage
description: Khufra pushes back all enemy targets around him toward his front (this skill can only be interrupted by Suppression), dealing 300 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing them down for 1.25s. If the enemies are knocked against walls, extra Physical Damage equal to 150% of this skill's damage will be inflicted upon them, and they will be stunned, instead of slowed.

name: Capriccio
description:
Granger's unique Demon Hunting Gun and Cannon are powered by Demonic Energy. Both his weapons start with 800 max Energy. His Gun restores 8% Energy per second while his Cannon restores 2% Energy per second. Killing a Minion / Creep permanently increases their max Energy by 6 / 6, and instantly restores their Energy by 5% / 5%, respectively. Each kill or assist on an enemy hero permanently increases both weapons' max Energy by 12 and instantly restores 10% Energy.

Every 1% Cooldown Reduction converts to 2 . Demonic Energy costs are not affected by Energy Cost Reduction.

name: Rhapsody
description:
Granger rapidly fires 6 shot(s) with his Gun, with each shot dealing 60 (+45% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and consuming 70 Gun Energy. The last shot is guaranteed to Crit. While firing, Granger's Movement Speed is increased by 10%.

Granger stops firing when he runs out of Energy, or when the skill is cast again. Rhapsody has no cooldown and can be cast once his Gun Energy is over 420.

name: Rondo
description:
Granger uses his Demon Hunter agility to dash in the target direction, instantly restoring 15% Energy for his Gun.

Rondo can be cast while channeling Rhapsody. Each time Rhapsody hits an enemy, Rondo's Cooldown is reduced by 0.5s.

name: Death Sonata
description:
Granger fires his Cannon in the target direction, dealing 150 (+110% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hero hit and other targets in the blast radius. Targets hit will be briefly slowed. Granger can roll in the Joystick's direction after each shot.
Death Sonata can be cast while firing Rhapsody. Death Sonata has a brief cooldown and consumes 250 of Granger's Cannon Energy per shot.

name: Super Magic
description:
Guinevere deals 25% extra damage to airborne enemies. Her Basic Attacks also deal (+80% Total Physical Attack) (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.
Guinevere gains Super Magic stacks each time she deals damage. At max stacks, her next Basic Attack becomes a guided attack, dealing 80 (+100% Total Physical Attack) (+90% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and recovering 80 (+ 8% of her ).
Enemies hit by Guinevere's skills or enhanced Basic Attack are marked for 5s. Enemies with 3 marks are knocked airborne when hit by Violet Requiem.

name: Energy Wave
description:
Guinevere releases an energy orb in the target direction, dealing 300 (+125% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing enemies by 25% for 1.2s.
Successfully hitting an enemy reduces all her skill cooldowns by 1s.

name: Spatial Migration
description:
Guinevere leaps to the target location, dealing 250 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Enemy heroes and Creeps hit will be knocked airborne for 1s and take 125 (+50% Total Magic Power) additional Magic Damage.
Use Again: Guinevere blinks toward the target direction and leaves an illusion behind. If the illusion takes damage by hero, it restores Super Magic for Guinevere and explodes after 1.5s, dealing 100 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies.

name: Violet Requiem
description:
Guinevere creates a force field around her, gaining Control Immunity while attacking nearby enemies 11 times within 2s, dealing 880 (+385% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage in total.
Airborne enemies hit will be knocked airborne again, up to 8 additional times.

name: Starmoon Casket
description:
Esmeralda manipulates Stardust and Frostmoon: Stardust deals Physical Damage while Frostmoon deals Magic Damage and gives the target a shield equal to 135% of Frostmoon's damage dealt. Each Basic Attack deals (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and 100 (+75% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.
The damage dealt by Esmeralda ignores all shield effects and gradually converts her shield into HP.

name: Frostmoon Shield
description: Esmeralda gains a 500 (+150% Total Magic Power) shield and 40% Movement Speed that rapidly decays over 4s. Meanwhile, she gradually transforms the shields of nearby enemies into her own shield, capped at 50% of her .

name: Stardust Dance
description: Esmeralda waves Stardust and Frostmoon, dealing 240 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and 300 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies. Each time she deals damage to a hero, the cooldown of Frostmoon Shield is reduced by 1.5s (damaging non-hero units grants a 0.5s reduction) and the enemy's Movement Speed is reduced by 20% for 1.5s.

name: Falling Starmoon
description:
Esmeralda coheres the power of Astrospace into her two weapons - Stardust and Frostmoon. The longer this skill is channeled, the longer the cast range.

Use Again: Esmeralda casts Stardust at the target location, dealing 350 (+90% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, and then blinks to the target location and casts Frostmoon, dealing 350 (+140% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and immobilizing enemies in the area for 1s.

name: Body of Smith
description:
Terizla gains 1% extra Damage Reduction (up to 20 (+1*Hero Level)%) for every 2.5% HP lost.
He cannot gain extra Attack Speed and will convert every 1% extra Attack Speed into 1 .

name: Revenge Strike
description:
Terizla strikes the ground with his hammer, sending a fissure forward that deals 300 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Upon hitting its first target, the fissure burrows into them, slowing them by 15%. Terizla also gains 15% Movement Speed for 3.5s.

The fissure then explodes, dealing 300 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) (+ 20% of the target's lost ) Physical Damage.

name: Execution Strike
description:
Terizla swings his hammer in a fan-shaped area ahead. This skill can be cast up to 3 times. The first two attacks deal 90 (+135% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage each, while the third deals 225 (+220% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Enemies hit will also be slowed by 20% for 1.25s (the Slowing Effect can stack).
Deals only 80% damage to Minions.

name: Penalty Zone
description: Terizla jumps to the designated area, dealing 300 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and knocking enemies airborne for 0.6s. He then summons Scaffold and slows enemies by 25%. Scaffold will send out a hook at enemy heroes in range and pull them several times while dealing 150 (+30% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage each time.

name: Firaga Armor
description:
Firaga Armor inherits 160% of X.Borg's and absorbs all incoming damage when it's active. When destroyed, X.Borg rolls in the direction of the Joystick (he is invincible during this process). The Armor's energy will gradually regenerate while X.Borg is in the Armorless State. At full energy, X.Borg re-equips the Armor and restores it to 30% HP.
X.Borg's attacks cause enemies to enter the Overheated state. Enemies in the Overheated state will drop Firaga Supplies when they take damage from X.Borg. Picking up supplies restores 10% of the Armor's HP (or 10 Energy while in the Armorless State).
X.Borg's skills deal True Damage to enemies in the Overheated state.

name: Fire Missiles
description:
X.Borg sprays fire, dealing 25 (+60% Total Physical Attack) (+40% Total Magic Power) Physical Damage 7 times over 2s to enemies in front of him (75% damage to minions).

Armorless State: The attack area becomes narrower but longer, while the damage is reduced to 60%.

name: Fire Stake
description:
X.Borg fires 5 Fire Stakes forward and recalls them after 1.7s. Each stake deals 50 (+20% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and pulls enemies and Firaga Supplies along its path back to him.

Armorless State: X.Borg adjusts the Fire Stake launcher, making the stakes travel farther and closer together.

name: Last Insanity
description:
X.Borg charges in the target direction while spinning and spraying fire (cannot pick up Firaga Supplies during this time), dealing 90 (+60% Extra Physical Attack) (+45% Total Magic Power) Physical Damage 12 times and slowing enemies hit by 25%. He stops upon touching an enemy hero and will slow them by an additional 40%.
After 3s, his mecha suit detonates, dealing 300 (+ 15% target's ) True Damage. If his armor is destroyed, it will immediately explode, but damage drops to 50%. The detonation destroys his armor, removes all control effects, and collects all nearby Firaga Supplies. Cannot be used in Armorless State.

Use Again: Immediately stop spraying fire and detonate early.

name: Cloud Walker
description:
Ling's superb Lightness Skill allows him to leap among walls. He gains 4 extra Lightness Points per second when he's on a wall and 5 extra Lightness Points each time he deals damage.

Ling gains 1.6 times Crit Chance from all sources but only has 140% Crit Damage.

name: Finch Poise
description:
Passive: Ling's Crit Chance is increased by 2.5%.
Active: Ling leaps onto the designated wall and enters the Half-Stealth state, restoring Lightness Points faster and gaining 30% Movement Speed. Taking damage causes him to leave Half-Stealth. Being controlled makes him fall to the ground and slows him by 30% for 2s. When he uses this skill to jump from one wall to another, it does not trigger cooldown and refreshes Half-Stealth.

name: Defiant Sword
description:
Ling charges in the target direction and stabs nearby enemies, dealing them 300 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
If Ling casts this skill when he's on the wall (no energy cost), he'll dash to the target location on the ground, dealing 300 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and slowing them by 30% for 1.5s.
Defiant Sword is regarded as Basic Attack.

name: Tempest of Blades
description:
Ling leaps into the air, becoming invincible and gaining 10% extra Movement Speed for 1.5s. He ignores obstacles when in the air. He then lands on the ground, dealing 250 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and slowing them by 40% for 1.5s, knocking those in the center airborne for 1s, and creating a Sword Field for 8s.

Four Tempest of Blades will also appear on the edge of the Sword Field. Ling can touch them to reduce the cooldown of Finch Poise by 4s, reset the cooldown of Defiant Sword, and gain 25 Lightness Points.

name: Wrath of the Abyss
description:
When Dyrroth's Rage reaches 50%, he enhances Burst Strike and Spectre Step.

After every 2 Basic Attacks, Dyrroth releases a Circle Strike, dealing (+150% Total Physical Attack)- (+180% Total Physical Attack) (scales with level) Physical Damage to enemies in the circle (enhanced damage does not apply to turrets), and recovering 7%-10% (scales with level, halved against minions or turrets). This strike does not trigger Attack Effect.
Each time he damages an enemy, the cooldown of Burst Strike and Spectre Step is reduced by 1s.

Dyrroth recovers 2% - 5% Rage per second (scales with level).

name: Burst Strike
description:
Dyrroth releases a burst strike in a designated direction. Each burst deals 240 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies and slows them by 25% for 1.5s. (The damage decays against the same target and decreases to only 75% on minions.)

Abyss Enhanced: Burst Strike has a longer range, deals 140% of the original damage, and its Slowing Effect is doubled.

name: Spectre Step
description:
Dyrroth dashes in the target direction. He stops upon reaching the max distance or hitting an enemy hero or creep, dealing 230 (+60% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slightly knocking them back.

Use Again: Dyrroth locks onto a target and unleashes a Fatal Strike, dealing 345 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and reducing their by 40% for 4s.

Abyss Enhanced: Fatal Strike reaches further and deals 150% of the original damage, slows the target by an extra 90%, and reduces their by 60% for 4s.

name: Abysm Strike
description:
After a short delay, Dyrroth launches a destructive strike in the target direction, dealing 650 (+250% Extra Physical Attack) (+ 25% of the target's lost ) as Physical Damage to enemies in its path, and slowing them by 55% for 0.8s.
This skill can only be interrupted by Suppression.
Damage dealt to non-hero enemies is capped at 1500.

name: Angry Gloom
description:
Lylia gains power from Gloom, increasing her Movement Speed by 15%. Each Gloom upgrade further increases this bonus by 5%.
Gloom gains an upgrade each time he devours Shadow Energy, up to 5 times. Higher levels increase the detonation damage of Shadow Energy.

name: Magic Shockwave
description:
Lylia sends out Gloom with a shockwave, dealing 250 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in a line and slowing them by 30% for 1.5s.
If Gloom touches Shadow Energy, he will devour and detonate it.

name: Shadow Energy
description:
Lylia condenses Shadow Energy at the target area, dealing 90 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and briefly slowing them by 80%.
Shadow Energy detonates when devoured by Gloom, dealing 220 (+115% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies. Each Gloom upgrade increases the detonation damage by 20% (up to 80%).
Gloom restores 20% of Shadow Energy's recharge time upon hitting an enemy hero.
Lylia starts with the Shadow Energy skill, storing one charge every 6s.

name: Black Shoes
description:
Lylia returns to the Black Shoes' location 4s ago, restoring her HP and Mana to their previous state and recovering an extra 10% .
She also gains 20% Movement Speed for 2s.

name: Baxia Mark
description:
Baxia activates the "Baxia Mark" permanently, reducing the final damage received by 15 (+1*Hero Level).
At the same time, Baxia will reduce the Shield and HP Regen of enemies hit by his skills by 40% for 4s.

name: Baxia-Shield Unity
description:
Baxia retracts himself into his shield and accelerates forward. When hitting an enemy unit, he will deal 300 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to it and nearby enemies, stunning the target for 0.8s and slightly knocking nearby enemies back.
During the process of accelerating forward, use this skill again to launch Baxia upward so that he can cross obstacles and enemy minions. When leaping up, if there is an enemy hero under Baxia, he will strike this hero, dealing 375 (+75% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to this hero and nearby enemies, stunning the target hit for 1.5s, and slightly knocking other nearby enemy targets back.

name: Shield of Spirit
description:
Baxia throws out his shield, dealing 120 (+100% Total Magic Power) (+ 5% target's ) Magic Damage to enemies along the way, marking them for 5s, and slowing them by 50% for 1s. The shield disappears upon hitting the first enemy hero or creep.
Baxia can cast the skill again in a short while. If an enemy hero or creep is hit by the skill, the skill's cooldown will be reduced to 15%.

name: Tortoise’s Puissance
description:
Baxia holds his shield to the front and begins sprinting frantically, gaining 30% extra Movement Speed for 10s while leaving a lava path behind. Enemies on the path will take 40 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and be slowed by 15% for 0.5s every 0.5s.
For the duration, the Damage Reduction effect from Baxia Mark is increased to 200%.

name: Primal Pact
description:
Bear's Blessing: Masha has 3 HP bars, each inheriting 50% of her Equipment HP bonuses. When an HP bar is depleted, she removes control effects and blocks damage once. She gains Feral by dealing damage to enemy heroes or creeps. Feral converts into HP after leaving combat.
Power of Wildness: After Masha's skills deal damage to an enemy hero, she leaves a Wound in a random direction. Her Basic Attacks can break the Wound and cause her to enter the Feral state.
Feral: Masha gains 15 (+1*Hero Level)% Resilience, Attack Speed, and Movement Speed. Her next 3 Basic Attacks become fan-shaped claw strikes, dealing 3 (+2% Extra Physical Attack) (+0.2*Hero Level)% extra Physical Damage to enemies in the area (extra damage does not apply to Turrets) and recovering 4 (+0.4*Hero Level)% HP. It lasts 3s.
[C8Breaking a Wound again during the Feral state will refresh its duration. Up to 6 claw strikes can be stored.]

name: Feral Swipe
description:
Masha releases energy forward, dealing 250 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path.
If an enemy hero is hit, they are slowed by 50% for 1s.

name: Claw Strike
description:
Masha dashes in the target direction, dealing 120 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
[C8Whenever an HP bar is depleted, the cooldown of Claw Strike resets.]

name: Savage Maul
description: Masha charges toward an enemy hero, dealing 300 (+50% Extra Max HP) Physical Damage and stunning them for 1s while knocking back nearby enemies.

name: Tiger Pace
description:
Enemy heroes hit by Wanwan's attacks will have their weaknesses and positions exposed for 5s. When hitting an enemy's weakness, Wanwan deals 67 (+3*Hero Level) extra True Damage and increases their damage taken from her subsequent attacks by 10% for 5s.
Wanwan can dash a short distance after each arrow fired from her Basic Attack. The dash speed scales with her Attack Speed.

name: Swallow’s Path
description: Wanwan throws a Fire Swallow in the target direction, triggering Tiger Pace while dealing 120 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path. The Fire Swallow then turns into 3 rotating Swallow Daggers. After a short delay, these Swallow Daggers will fly back to Wanwan one after another, dealing 120 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies on their way back and slowing them by 30% for 1.5s. Enemies hit twice by the Swallow Daggers will be immobilized for 0.5s.

name: Needles in Flowers
description: Wanwan removes all debuffs on herself and triggers Tiger Pace. Meanwhile, she shoots Deadly Needles in all directions, dealing 150 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit.

name: Crossbow of Tang
description:
Wanwan leaps into the air and becomes untargetable, firing arrows at the target enemy hero for 2.5s in rapid succession, dealing 60 (+35% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage per arrow. If the target is killed during this attack, Wanwan will switch to another enemy hero in her attack range, gain 30% Attack Speed, and extend the skill duration by 1s (this effect can trigger up to 3 times). Wanwan can trigger Tiger Pace upon killing an enemy and at the end of the duration.
Crossbow of Tang can only be cast on enemy heroes with all their weaknesses hit and Wanwan gains 100% Movement Speed during the duration. This damage is regarded as Basic Attack damage, and the firing rate scales with Wanwan's Attack Speed.

name: Knightess' Resolve
description:
Silvanna's Basic Attacks deal 25 (+45% Total Physical Attack) (+75% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.
Silvanna's attacks apply a mark on enemy heroes for 5s on hit, each mark reducing their by 3-6 (up to 5 stacks).
Silvanna's skills and Basic Attacks deal 30% extra damage to enemy heroes with the max number of marks.

name: Cometic Lance
description: Silvanna dashes forward. Upon reaching the max range or hitting a non-Minion enemy, she swings her lance, dealing 250 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and stunning them for 1s.

name: Spiral Strangling
description:
Silvanna thrusts her lance in the target direction and spins it 6 times while gaining a 350 (+150% Total Magic Power) shield. Each spin deals 165 (+45% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slightly pulls targets toward the center. Silvanna spins 1 additional time for every 50% of extra Attack Speed she possesses.

The skill deals only 50% damage against Minions.

Spiral Strangling counts as a Basic Attack but cannot Crit.

name: Imperial Justice
description:
Silvanna leaps to the target location and creates a Circle of Light upon landing, dealing 350 (+110% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the area, slowing them by 40% for 1.5s, and restraining the closest enemy hero to the area for 3.5s. (This skill cannot be interrupted.)

Silvanna gains 100% Attack Speed and 40% Lifesteal when in the Circle.

name: Overflowing
description:
Cecilion gains 10 extra Max Mana and recovers 10 Mana each time his skill hits an enemy. Cooldown: 1s.

Cecilion has higher Max Mana and Mana Regen, and his skill damage scales with his Max Mana.

name: Bat Impact
description:
Cecilion commands a giant bat to dive at the target location, gaining 30% extra Movement Speed for 1s, dealing 85 (+70% Total Magic Power) (+7% Total Mana) Magic Damage to enemies in its path. The bat also deals 170 (+140% Total Magic Power) (+14% Total Mana) extra Magic Damage to those near the landing point, and applies Overflowing effect once.

Each subsequent cast within 6s increases this skill's Mana cost by 1.5 times (up to 4 stacks).

name: Sanguine Claws
description: Cecilion summons a pair of opposing claws at the target location that will clasp together after a short delay, pulling enemies in their paths to the center while dealing them 200 (+45% Total Magic Power) (+1.2% Total Mana) Magic Damage and immobilizing them for 1s.

name: Bats Feast
description:
Cecilion unleashes his Blood Demon power, gaining 60% Movement Speed (decays over the duration) and Slow Immunity for 1.5s.

Meanwhile, he fires 36 bolts of blood energy at nearby enemies, each dealing 35 (+8% Total Magic Power) (+0.3% Total Mana) Magic Damage and slowing enemies hit by 3% for 1s (up to 30%total).
Each bolt that hits restores HP equal to 10 plus 1% of Cecilion's lost .

name: Moonlit Waltz
description:
When Carmilla is nearby, Cecilion can summon her to become a Vermil Shadow around him, granting him a 520-800 shield (scales with Carmilla's level).
Carmilla can choose to leave Cecilion and charge at the target location, gaining an equal shield while dealing 520-800 Magic Damage (scales with level) to nearby enemies and slowing them by 30% for 1s.

name: Vampire Pact
description: Each time Carmilla deals damage to an enemy hero, she steals 6-13 (scales with level) from them. The stolen can stack up to 5 times and lasts 5s. However, Carmilla can only steal defense from the same enemy hero once every 3s.

name: Crimson Flower
description:
Carmilla summons three Crimson Flowers that circle around her for 5s, dealing 85 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage each time they hit an enemy and slowing them by 6% for 0.8s (the slow effect stacks up to 30%).

Carmilla recovers 45 (+21% Total Magic Power) HP each time a Crimson Flower deals damage (only recovers 30% of that amount when hitting minions).

name: Bloodbath
description:
Carmilla accumulates Bloodbath Energy, gaining 70% Movement Speed that decays over 4.5s.

Use Again: Carmilla unleashes the accumulated Bloodbath Energy on the target enemy hero or Creep, dealing 150 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and stunning them for 0.6s. The damage and stun duration scale with the accumulation time (up to 100%).

name: Curse of Blood
description:
Carmilla casts Curse of Blood on the target location, slowing enemies hit by 50%. After 0.8s, enemies still within the area will take 450 (+130% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, and will be immobilized for 1s, slowed by 30% and linked for 5s.

When a linked enemy takes damage or becomes controlled, all the other linked targets take 50% of the damage and become controlled for 100% of the duration. Enemies can move away from one another to break the link.

name: Frigid Breath
description:
Atlas generates Frigid Breath around him for 5s each time he casts a skill. Enemies affected by Frigid Breath will have their Movement Speed gradually reduced over 2s, after which they'll be frozen for 0.5s.

Atlas gains 20 (+0.5% Extra Max HP) extra when Frigid Breath is present.

name: Annihilate
description:
Atlas smashes the ground and causes 3 explosions, dealing 400 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies.

Ejected State: If Atlas is ejected from his Mecha Sentry, both he and his Mecha will cast Annihilate.

name: Perfect Match
description:
Atlas enters Ejected State, gaining 30% Movement Speed and immunity to Slowing Effects. In this state, the Mecha Sentry will follow the pilot at an increasing speed (can only be controlled by Suppression). Once they meet, Atlas will return to the Mecha, dealing 320 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies nearby and stunning them for 0.8s.
Ejected State: Atlas and his Mecha share the same HP bar and reduce 50% of the damage taken in this state.

name: Fatal Links
description:
Atlas hurls chains around and starts to channel (can only be interrupted by Suppression), dealing 225 (+75% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemy heroes hit and slowing them by 40% for 3s.
Release the skill while channeling: Atlas will drag the targets toward him and plunk them down on the designated location, dealing 360 (+180% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.
Use this skill in Ejected State: The Mecha Sentry will return to Atlas immediately, but the stun effect will be replaced by 40% Slowing Effect.

name: We Are Friends
description:
Kupa recovers 10% per second after not taking damage for 5s. When Kupa is killed, Popol can Pray for 3s to bring Kupa back to the battlefield. Cooldown: 30s.
Every 3 consecutive attacks from Kupa will enhance Popol's next Basic Attack to deal (+220% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Kupa has 2500 (+1200% Total Physical Attack) and inherits 100% of Popol's other attributes and passive equipment effects (excluding Jungling and Roaming equipment effects).
Kupa deals an additional 120% damage against creeps.

name: Bite 'em, Kupa!
description:
Popol throws a spear at the target enemy, dealing 80 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage while simultaneously commanding Kupa to lunge at the target, dealing an additional 70 (+75% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Kupa will continue to attack the target for 3s.
Alpha Wolf Form: Kupa stuns the enemy for 1s and bites them 3 times in quick succession.

name: Kupa, Help!
description:
Popol summons Kupa back to his side, gaining a 240 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) shield while dealing 240 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 35% for 0.5s. Kupa will then assist Popol to attack nearby enemies for 3s.
Alpha Wolf Form: Kupa darts back to Popol, knocking nearby enemies airborne for 0.2s. The shield and damage are increased to 125%.

name: Popol's Surprise
description:
Popol sets a trap at the target location that will detonate after a short delay once triggered, dealing 70 (+20% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the enemy that steps on it, immobilizing them for 1s, and creating a frost zone for 4s. Enemies in the frost zone will have their Movement Speed reduced by 20%.
Popol gains a trap charge every 22s (up to 3). Up to 3 traps can exist at the same time on the battlefield, each lasting up to 60s.

name: We Are Angry!
description:
Popol and Kupa enter the Enraged state for 12s, gaining 15% extra Movement Speed and increasing their Attack Speed to 1.3 times.
Kupa turns into Alpha Wolf Form, gaining 1500 , fully recovering its HP, while enhancing its other skills.

name: Bite 'em, Kupa!
description:
Popol throws a spear at the target enemy, dealing 80 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage while simultaneously commanding Kupa to lunge at the target, dealing an additional 70 (+75% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Kupa will continue to attack the target for 3s.
Alpha Wolf Form: Kupa stuns the enemy for 1s and bites them 3 times in quick succession.

name: Kupa, Help!
description:
Popol summons Kupa back to his side, gaining a 240 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) shield while dealing 240 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 35% for 0.5s. Kupa will then assist Popol to attack nearby enemies for 3s.
Alpha Wolf Form: Kupa darts back to Popol, knocking nearby enemies airborne for 0.2s. The shield and damage are increased to 125%.

name: Cursing Touch
description:
Yu Zhong applies Sha Residue to enemy heroes each time he damages them.

Sha Residue erupts upon reaching 5 stacks on a target. Then it begins consuming 1 stack every 0.4s to deal Physical Damage equal to 20 (+20% Extra Physical Attack) (+ 2.5% of target's ) to the target. Each stack consumed recovers 6% of Yu Zhong's . Yu Zhong also gains 30% Movement Speed for 3s.

name: Dragon Tail
description: Yu Zhong infuses his power into his cloak and turns it into a weapon, which starts to attack nearby enemies after a short delay. The inner area of the cloak deals 220 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage, whereas the sharpened edge deals 275% damage and applies 2 stacks of Sha Residue.

name: Soul Grip
description:
Yu Zhong unleashes the Dragon Soul, dealing 150 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in front and slowing them by 60% for 1s.

Upon hitting an enemy, Yu Zhong's next Basic Attack will be enhanced, dealing 108 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Upon hitting multiple enemies, the enhanced Basic Attack will apply multiple stacks of Sha Residue and deal up to 200% damage.

name: Furious Dive
description:
Yu Zhong leaps towards the designated area with his full strength, dealing 180 (+90% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage. He is able to dash one more time in the movement direction.
After a short delay, enemies within the area of effect will be knocked airborne for 0.6s and take 180 (+90% Extra Physical Attack) additional Physical Damage.

name: Black Dragon Form
description:
After channeling for 0.6s, Yu Zhong transforms into his Black Dragon Form. For up to 7s, he cannot use other skills but can move freely and will knock back enemy heroes in his path while dealing 180 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. He also gains 1000 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) , becomes immune to control effects, and ignores obstacles in this form.
Upon exiting the Black Dragon Form, Yu Zhong enters Dragonoid Form, gaining increased range on all of his skills for 10s.

name: Duality
description:
Luo Yi's skills can create Sigils of Yin/Yang on the battlefield. Each Sigil lasts up to 6s.
Sigils of opposite attributes will trigger Yin-Yang Reaction when they are within a certain distance, dealing 300 (+25*Hero Level) (+190% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the marked enemies, stunning them for 0.3s, and pulling them toward each other.
Each time Luo Yi applies a new Sigil to a marked enemy, she gains a 300 (+10*Hero Level) (+150% Total Magic Power) shield (up to 3 stacks) and 50% extra Movement Speed that decays over 2s.

name: Dispersion
description:
Luo Yi casts the energy of Yin/Yang in the target direction, dealing 285 (+135% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hit and those behind them in a fan-shaped area. Enemy heroes hit are marked with a Sigil of Yin/Yang.
Luo Yi stores up to 4 Dispersion charges and gains 1 charge every 8s. She also immediately gains 1 charge each time Yin-Yang Reaction is triggered.
The state of this skill changes on each cast.

name: Rotation
description:
Luo Yi summons Fire of Yang / Aqua of Yin at the target location, dealing 250 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 60% for 0.5s.
Fire of Yang / Aqua of Yin then remains at the location for 6s, dealing 50 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.7s to nearby enemies. It can also trigger Yin-Yang Reaction with Sigils of opposite attributes.
The state of this skill changes on each cast.

name: Diversion
description:
Passive: Luo Yi's Cooldown Reduction is increased by 6%.
Active: Luo Yi creates a Teleport Circle around herself and marks the target location (within 28 units) as its destination. After a 3s delay, allied heroes within the Circle will be teleported to the location.

name: Elapsed Daytime
description:
Hold the Basic Attack button to enter the Swordout state and charge Sword Intent. Once fully charged, release it to perform a Swordout Slash in the direction she's facing and dash forward, dealing (+215% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies on the path (counts as basic attack damage and is reduced to 50% against minions and creeps).

Benedetta can only cast Swordout Slash when her Sword Intent is full and she is in the Swordout state.

Benedetta also gains Sword Intent by dealing damage with her Basic Attacks and skills.

name: Phantom Slash
description:
Benedetta withdraws swiftly and leaves a shadow in front. After a short delay, her shadow slashes forward in a fan-shaped area, dealing 200 (+75% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing the enemies by 60% for 0.5s.

Meanwhile, Benedetta dashes forward to slash, dealing 75 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. (If the target is hit by her shadow, damage caused by Benedetta herself will increase to 200%.)

name: An Eye for An Eye
description:
Benedetta raises her weapon to defend, gaining Control Immunity and blocking damage from any source for 0.8s. After this, she stabs in the designated direction, dealing 300 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

If Benedetta successfully fends off any damage while defending, she will gain full Sword Intent. If she fends off any control effects, her subsequent stab stuns the target for 1.5s.

name: Alecto: Final Blow
description: Benedetta clenches Alecto, dashes forward (Benedetta is untargetable during the dash), and performs a slash after a short delay, detonating the Sword Intent along the path. For 2.5s, the Sword Intent deals up to a total of 1560 (+1105% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies within and slows them by 50%.

name: Sand Walk
description: Khaleed accumulates Desert Power while moving. After Desert Power is fully charged, he will glide on sand, increasing Movement Speed by 35%, making his next Basic Attack deal 50 (+140% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target (cannot Crit), and reducing the target's Movement Speed by 40% for 1.5s.

name: Desert Tornado
description:
Khaleed whirls his scimitar, dealing 175 (+130% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and pulling them toward him. This skill can be used up to 3 time(s) in a row.

This skill deals 60% damage to Minions and Creeps.

name: Quicksand Guard
description:
Khaleed protects himself with quicksand, restoring HP equal to 60 + 5% of his and 10 Desert Power every 0.5s. He also gains 25% Damage Reduction for up to 4s.

While channeling, quicksand appears beneath him, slowing the enemy by 60%.
This is a Focused Cast. Other control effects will interrupt this skill.

name: Raging Sandstorm
description:
Khaleed rides the sandstorm and charges toward a designated location, dealing 100 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way and knocking them toward his destination. Khaleed is immune to control effects during this process.

Upon reaching the destination, Khaleed will smash the ground, dealing 450 (+160% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and stunning them for 1s, and fully charge his Desert Power.

name: Big Guy
description: Detona gains a stack of Big Guy for 12s each time it or Barats damages an enemy with their skills (up to 10 stacks). Each stack of Big Guy increases Detona's size and grants 4 - 10 (scales with the level of Detona's Welcome). At max stacks, Detona gains 20% extra Resilience, and its Basic Attacks are replaced with Trample, which deals (+140% Total Physical Attack) (+3.5% Max HP) Physical Damage to enemies in a circular area, slows them by 40% for 0.2s, and refreshes the duration of Big Guy with each hit.

name: So-Called Teamwork
description:
Detona spits contaminated oil in the target direction, dealing 60 (+7% Max HP) Physical Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area. Barats then ignites the oil with a firecracker, dealing 120 (+180% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area (only 50% damage to Creeps).

The area of effect of So-Called Teamwork increases with the number of Big Guy stacks.

name: Missile "Expert"
description: Barats fires two missiles at the target location, dealing 100 (+75% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing enemies by 40% for 1s. The missiles expel fumes from their exhausts upon landing, dealing 100 (+75% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a rectangular area and pushing them toward Barats.

name: Detona's Welcome
description:
After a short delay, Detona charges in the target direction, dealing 120 (+70% Total Physical Attack) (+1.2% Max HP) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit, devouring and suppressing them for 1.2s, then spitting them out. If the spat‑out target hits an enemy hero or a wall, it triggers an explosion. The target and nearby enemies take an additional 180 (+105% Total Physical Attack) (+5% Max HP) Physical Damage and are stunned for 1s.

During the skill, Barats becomes immune to control effects. If the cast is canceled or the skill misses, 50% of the skill cooldown is refunded.
If Detona successfully devours an enemy, he immediately gains max stacks of Big Guy.

name: Abyss Corrosion
description:
With his Basic Attacks resonated with the Abyss Power within his body, Brody is able to move while winding up his Basic Attacks (which will be interrupted when casting skills), at the cost of having longer Basic Attack Animation and lower Attack Speed Bonus. Each Basic Attack deals (+140% Total Physical Attack) (+45*Hero Level) Physical Damage (of which the damage scaling with level cannot be critical), increases Movement Speed by 30% (which will decay rapidly in 1.2s), and applies 1 stack of Abyss Mark on the enemy, capped at 4 stacks.
Each stack of Abyss Mark increases Brody's damage against the target by 5% and his Movement Speed by 5%.

name: Abyss Impact
description:
Brody launches a shockwave in the target direction, dealing 200 (+170% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing enemies by 30% for 1.2s while applying one stack of Abyss Mark.

For each enemy hit by the shockwave, they take an extra 5% slow and one extra Abyss Mark stack (capped at 45% slow and 4 stacks).

name: Corrosive Strike
description:
Brody dashes to an enemy, dealing 200 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target, stunning the target for 0.8s, and applying 1 stack of Abyss Mark on the target.
Upon hitting the target, he is able to move one more time in the movement direction, gaining 45% Movement Speed that will decay rapidly in 1.2s.

name: Torn-Apart Memory
description:
Brody locks onto all enemies within 8 unit(s), dealing 216 (+165% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to them.
For each target with Abyss Mark stacks, all stacks are consumed, dealing additional Physical Damage equal to 94 (+72% Extra Physical Attack) (+ 4% of the target's lost ) per stack.

name: Galactic Power
description: When Yve deals damage to enemy heroes with her skills, she gains Galactic Power (cooldown: 0.5s), up to 3 stacks. Each stack provides Yve with a 120 (+10*Hero Level) (+50% Total Magic Power) shield for 3s.

name: Void Blast
description:
Yve detonates Galactic Energy at the target location, dealing 290 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the area.
Successfully hitting an enemy grants Yve 55% extra Movement Speed (halved if a non-hero enemy is hit) that decreases over 1s.

name: Void Crystal
description:
Yve summons a Void Crystal at the target location, dealing 220 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies.

Use Again: Yve commands the Crystal to fire materialized energy in the target direction for 2.7s, dealing 75 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.45s to enemies hit and slowing them by 20%. Enemies hit multiple times are slowed by an extra 4% for each hit after the first hit (up to 40%).

name: Real World Manipulation
description:
Yve creates a Starfield that lasts 15s. Within the duration, you can Tap or Swipe the screen to attack up to 20 times.
Tap: Deals 340 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the target area.
Swipe: Deals 85 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.45s to enemies in the target area for 2.7s and slows them by 40%.
Enemies leaving or entering the Starfield will be immobilized for 0.8s (only once against the same target).
Yve cannot be displaced while the Starfield is active, and the Starfield will remain even if Yve is controlled (except for Suppression).

name: Ancestral Guidance
description: Mathilda gains Ancestral Guidance while moving. When it's fully charged, her next Basic Attack will be enhanced, dealing 200 (+100% Total Physical Attack) (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the target and granting her 80 extra Movement Speed that decays over 2.5s.

name: Soul Bloom
description:
Mathilda resonates with the power of her ancestors for 4s, attracting wisps as her movement distance increases (up to 6 wisps).

At the end of the skill's duration, or when Mathilda casts this skill again, the wisps will seek and attack nearby enemies, each dealing 275 (+125% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and revealing the enemies' positions briefly. Subsequent damage dealt by wisps to the same target decays to 40%.

name: Guiding Wind
description:
Mathilda leaps in the target direction and creates a field around her, gaining a 350 (+180% Total Magic Power) shield and 25% extra Movement Speed for 3s. Allied heroes who come into contact with the field will receive a 50% shield and Guiding Wind. The first allied hero that triggers Guiding Wind will be guided to Mathilda, and both of them will gain the same Movement Speed boost.

When casting this skill during Circling Eagle, Mathilda won't change her position.
Guiding Wind expires 2s after the hero leaves Mathilda's field.

name: Circling Eagle
description:
Mathilda applies a Soul Mark to the target enemy hero and circles around them for up to 3.5s, during which her wisps will fly into nearby enemies, each dealing 40 (+15% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. The Soul Mark will also slow the target by 15% and Soul Bloom will prioritize the target with Soul Mark.
Within the duration, Mathilda can select an area to dash to. At the end of the duration, she'll dash at the target with Soul Mark, dealing 320 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage while knocking enemies in her path airborne for 0.6s, transferring the Soul Mark to the first enemy hero that she knocks airborne, and reducing the skill cooldown by 40%.
Mathilda gains Control Immunity and a 400 (+180% Total Magic Power) shield for the skill duration.

name: Champ Stance
description:
Paquito gains a stack each time he casts a skill. At 3 stacks, he enters the Champ Stance and enhances his next skill.
Paquito's enhanced skills have no cooldown and deal (+2*Hero Level)% extra damage to minions.

After casting any enhanced skill, Paquito gains 60% Movement Speed and (+2*Hero Level)% Damage Reduction for 1.2s.

name: Heavy Left Punch
description:
Paquito throws a punch in the target direction, dealing 210 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and gaining a 150 (+135% Total Physical Attack) shield.

Champ Stance: The damage is increased to 350 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, and the shield value is increased to 140% for 2.5s (normal and enhanced shields can stack).

name: Jab
description:
Paquito dashes forward and throws a jab, dealing 200 (+165% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in his path and at the destination.

Champ Stance: Paquito's jab becomes fiercer, dealing 300 (+210% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit.
The jab stops upon hitting a hero or creep.

name: Knockout Strike
description:
Paquito launches an elbow strike at enemies in the target direction, dealing 250 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and knocking them back to the destination.
He then throws a haymaker, dealing 300 (+90% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing them by 75% for 1s, before darting backward.

Champ Stance: After knocking enemies back to the destination, Paquito launches an uppercut instead, dealing 400 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and knocking them airborne for 0.5s.

name: Stick, Stick
description:
Gloo's skills apply a stack of Sticky to enemies on hit, decreasing their Movement Speed by 4% for 6s (up to 5 stacks).
Each Sticky stack on an attacker reduces their damage dealt to Gloo by 3%.

name: Slam, Slam
description:
Gloo reaches out and slams the ground, dealing 80 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit.
A Goo is left at the end location, which explodes after 3s, dealing 250 (+12% Extra Max HP) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and immobilizing them for 0.8s.
Touching the Goo detonates it immediately and resets this skill's cooldown. Gloo also recovers 2.5% if the explosion hits an enemy (doubled if it hits an enemy hero).

name: Spread, Spread
description:
Gloo splits into Goos, dealing 100 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area and immobilizing them for 0.5s. For the next 4s, Gloo gains 10% Movement Speed and deals 80 (+15% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.25s to enemies it touches.
If this skill hits a Goo, Gloo charges toward it, dragging enemies in its path along for a distance.

name: Grab, Grab
description:
Unlocked when an enemy hero reaches max Sticky stacks. Gloo attaches itself to the target for up to 9s, recovering 20% .
