While attached, Gloo's Basic Attacks deal 30 (+50% Total Magic Power) (+6% Extra Max HP) Magic Damage, and it transfers 80% of the damage it takes (excluding Turret damage) to the host. If the host dies while Gloo is attached, this skill's cooldown is reduced to 5s.

name: Mechanical Genius
description:
Beatrix's talent for mechanics allowed her to produce 4 weapons of truly awe-inspiring firepower.

Renner Basic Attack - Longshot: Fires a powerful shot in the target's direction, dealing (+365% Total Physical Attack) - (+400% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first target hit (75% damage against creeps). This shot can be dodged or blocked by others.

Beatrix cannot Crit. She converts every 1% Crit Chance into 2 .
She gains Spell Vamp equal to 100% of her Lifesteal.

name: Masterful Gunner
description:
Passive: Beatrix can carry 2 weapons at once, increasing her by 5.
Active: Beatrix takes 0.5s to swap her primary weapon with the secondary weapon, gaining a new Basic Attack and Ultimate.

name: Tactical Reposition
description: Beatrix rolls forward while fully reloading her current weapon.

name: Renner's Apathy
description:
Beatrix calmly sets up Renner on the battlefield and takes aim. When releasing the skill, she deals 700 (+280% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit.

Beatrix can aim for up to 8s, and she can cancel it early to reduce the cooldown by 50%.

This shot can penetrate Minions and only deals 75% damage to non-hero units.

name: Need Backup
description:
Having escaped battle for 3s, Beatrix can call for her butler Morgan to provide her with a backup weapons crate.
Beatrix must then choose two from the crate to serve as her primary and secondary weapons.
Her weapon selection is interrupted if she commits any action or is controlled during this period.

name: Mechanical Genius
description:
Beatrix's talent for mechanics allowed her to produce 4 weapons of truly awe-inspiring firepower.

Bennett Basic Attack - Area Bombing: Bombards an area, dealing (+230% Total Physical Attack) - (+300% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in range and slowing them by 40% for 0.5s (75% damage against creeps).

Beatrix cannot Crit. She converts every 1% Crit Chance into 2 .
She gains Spell Vamp equal to 100% of her Lifesteal.

name: Tactical Reposition
description: Beatrix leaps nimbly forward, and fully reloads her current weapon.

name: Bennett's Rage
description:
Beatrix focuses her rage and has Bennett rain down a bombardment on the target area 5 time(s). Each bombardment slows enemies by 40% and deals 580 (+225% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage (this damage decays to 20% when hitting the same target multiple times), lasting 1s.

This skill only deals 75% damage to non-hero units.

name: Mechanical Genius
description:
Beatrix's talent for mechanics allowed her to produce 4 weapons of truly awe-inspiring firepower.

Wesker Basic Attack - Proximity Advantage: Fires 5 shots at the target, each dealing (+178% Total Physical Attack) - (+220% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage (75% damage against creeps) and inheriting a portion of Attack Effects. Damage dealt to targets hit multiple times decays to 25%.

Beatrix cannot Crit. She converts every 1% Crit Chance into 2 .
She gains Spell Vamp equal to 100% of her Lifesteal.

name: Tactical Reposition
description: Beatrix rolls ahead sideways, and fully reloads her current weapon.

name: Wesker's Elation
description:
Beatrix raises Wesker and fires off ultra bullets that deal 350 (+155% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage each time they hit an enemy (the damage of subsequent hits on the same enemy will decay to 25%).

This skill only deals 75% damage to non-hero units.

name: Mechanical Genius
description:
Beatrix's talent for mechanics allowed her to produce 4 weapons of truly awe-inspiring firepower.

Nibiru Basic Attack - Rapid Fire: Fires a volley of 4 shots at the target, each dealing (+51% Total Physical Attack) - (+65% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage (75% damage against creeps) and inheriting a portion of Attack Effects.

Beatrix cannot Crit. She converts every 1% Crit Chance into 2 .
She gains Spell Vamp equal to 100% of her Lifesteal.

name: Tactical Reposition
description: Beatrix slides forward, and fully reloads her current weapon.

name: Nibiru's Passion
description:
Beatrix unleashes 10 volleys of bullets using Nibiru, each dealing 130 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

This skill only deals 75% damage to non-hero units.

name: Demonic Force
description:
Phoveus's next Basic Attack charges at the enemy, knocking them back, dealing extra Magic Damage equal to 4% - 6% of the enemy's (scales with level), and gaining a 8% - 12% shield. Cooldown: 26s-14s (based on Infernal Pursuit's level).

Astaros' Gaze: Whenever an enemy hero blinks, dashes, or is displaced within 8 units, reduces the cooldown of Demonic Force by 20% and other skills by 0.5s.

name: Demonic Impact
description:
Phoveus slams his monolith into the ground, dealing 200 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and slowing them by 70% for 0.5s. If this skill hits an enemy, Phoveus's next Demonic Impact will leave behind an Astaros Eye.

Astaros Eye: Implodes after a short delay, dealing 100 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Magic Damage to the enemies.

name: Dark Wave
description: Phoveus lowers his monolith and releases his demonic power in the target direction, knocking enemies airborne, dragging them along, and dealing 250 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Magic Damage.

name: Infernal Pursuit
description:
Passive: Demonic Force, Astaros Eye, and Dark Wave apply Sinner's Mark to enemy heroes hit.

Active: Phoveus leaps into the air and smashes down with his monolith at the enemy hero with Sinner's Mark, dealing 250 (+100% Total Physical Attack) (+ 5% target's ) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and recovering 50 (+ 6% of his ).

Infernal Pursuit can only be used when there are enemies with Sinner's Mark nearby. HP recovered is reduced by 80% when multiple enemies are hit.

name: Theory of Everything
description:
Natan gains a stack of Entanglement each time he or his Reverse-Clone hits an enemy with a skill (up to 6 stacks). Each stack lasts 2.5s and grants 7.5% Attack Speed and 5% Movement Speed.
Natan's Basic Attack projectiles will return to Natan after reaching the maximum range, dealing an extra 30 (+50% Total Physical Attack) (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies along the way (inherits a portion of Attack Effects). Hitting an enemy refreshes Entanglement's duration.

name: Superposition
description: Natan shoots a dense mass of energy in the target direction, dealing 225 (+100% Total Physical Attack) (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in its path.

name: Interference!
description:
Natan launches a Gravitational Attractor in the target direction, dealing 150 (+50% Total Physical Attack) (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in its path and knocking them back.
The Attractor detonates upon reaching the maximum range, dealing 30 (+10% Total Physical Attack) (+12% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and knocking them back.

name: Entropy?
description:
Natan summons a Reverse-Clone that lasts 10s at 6 units away. The Reverse-Clone copies his moves and attacks in reverse and inherits 35% of his Basic Attack and skill damage.
Use Again: Natan switches places with the Reverse-Clone.

Each cast reduces other skills' remaining cooldowns by 50%. The Reverse-Clone will disappear if Natan is too far away.

name: Fighting Spirit
description:
Whenever Aulus deals skill damage to a unit, he gains an enhanced Basic Attack for 2s (capped at 4s).
Enhanced Basic Attack: Aulus raises his axe and slams it into the ground, dealing 135 (+15*Hero Level) (+75% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a line and recovering 30 (+15% Total Physical Attack) HP. Enemies hit are slowed by 10% for 1s. Aulus also gains 0.5 Attack Range and 20 (+2*Hero Level)% Attack Speed for 1s.
Enhanced Basic Attack deals 270 (+30*Hero Level) (+75% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to creeps.

name: Aulus, Charge!
description:
Aulus starts accumulating Fighting Spirit, removes all slow effects, and gains 30% extra Movement Speed for 5s.

If Aulus does not take high-level control effects within 2s, he will enter the Enraged state and gain Control Immunity.

name: The Power of Axe
description:
Aulus swings his axe, dealing 240 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area and stunning them for 0.3s.

Use Again: Aulus dashes forward and smashes the ground, dealing 240 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies.

name: Cleaving Axe
description:
Aulus repeatedly swings his axe at nearby enemies, dealing 110 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage each time. After 4 strikes, Aulus briefly charges before unleashing a wider slash, dealing 330 (+180% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a large area.

During this skill, Aulus gains 20% Damage Reduction and a short burst of Movement Speed with each slash.

name: Invisible Armor
description:
Each time Aamon hits an enemy with a skill, he enters Camouflage, becoming untargetable, recovering HP equal to 25 (+15% Total Magic Power) (+ 3% of his ) every 0.5s, and gaining 80% Movement Speed that rapidly decays over 3s.

Upon leaving the Camouflage state, Aamon immediately resets his Basic Attack's cooldown and enhances his Basic Attacks for 3s. Each enhanced Basic Attack deals 70 (+100% Total Physical Attack) (+115% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. The first attack after manually leaving Camouflage instead deals 84 (+120% Total Physical Attack) (+138% Total Magic Power) damage and reduces all skill cooldowns by 1s.

name: Soul Shards
description:
Passive: Aamon charges his armor through enhanced Basic Attacks or while camouflaged. At 5 charges, Aamon throws 6 shards at the target on his next attack, each shard dealing 50 (+15% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. The shards will then scatter around the target.

Active: Aamon throws a shard at a nearby enemy, dealing 175 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.

name: Slayer Shards
description:
Aamon throws a shard forward, dealing 120 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing enemies hit by 50% for 2s. The shard returns to Aamon after a short delay, granting him the Camouflage state.

If the shard hits a non-minion enemy, it returns immediately.

name: Endless Shards
description:
Aamon throws all shards at a designated enemy and slows them by 30% for 1.5s. After a short delay, the shards will fly to the enemy's location again, each dealing 35 (+10% Total Magic Power)-70 (+20% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.

The number of shards increases with Aamon's armor charges and the shards on the ground (8-25).
The damage dealt increases with the target's lost , to the max when the target's HP is below 30%.

name: Primal Force
description:
Valentina gains 8-50 extra EXP (scales with level) each time she deals damage to an enemy hero. Cooldown: 2s.
If the enemy hero's level is not higher than hers, 30% of the damage dealt is converted into her HP.

name: Shadow Strike
description:
Valentina casts Shadow Strike in the target direction, dealing 475 (+145% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 40% for 1s.
Enemy heroes hit are marked with a Shadow Sigil for 4s. Marked enemies hit by Shadow Strike again are Terrified for 1s (a target can only be terrified once every 4s).

name: Arcane Shade
description:
Valentina dashes in the target direction, firing 3 Shadow Bolts at nearby enemies that deal 90 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage each. She can cast this skill again within 6s (costs Mana).

Each time a Shadow Bolt hits an enemy, the cooldown of Shadow Strike is reduced by 1s.

name: I Am You
description:
Valentina slows the target enemy hero by 70% for 0.5s and gains the ability to cast their Ultimate. Casting the enemy's Ultimate turns her into the enemy hero's form and inherits their Basic Attack type for up to 12s (her regular skills remain unchanged unless the enemy's Ultimate has a Morph effect).
The stolen Ultimate's level equals Valentina's own Ultimate level, and its cooldown is 120% of the target's (but no lower than 10s).
If the target is a Physical Damage hero, Valentina gains (+100% Total Magic Power) for the duration. This cannot be used on an enemy Valentina.

name: Overload
description:
After each skill cast, Edith and Phylax become Overloaded for 3s, during which all Basic Attacks will trigger chain lightning, dealing (+20% Total Magic Power) (+ 3 (+0.2*Hero Level)% target's ) extra Magic Damage to up to 4 enemies.
Chain lightning damage against minions is increased to 150%.

name: Earth Shatter
description:
After a 0.75s delay, Edith controls Phylax to launch an earth-shattering blow in a designated direction, dealing 225 (+10% Max HP) Physical Damage to enemies hit (deals 120% damage to minions) and knocking them airborne for 0.8s.
This skill can only be interrupted by Suppression.

name: Onward
description:
Edith controls Phylax to charge in the target direction, dealing 90 (+3% Max HP) Physical Damage to enemies along the way.

If Phylax hits an enemy hero during the charge, it will stop immediately and throw them over its shoulder, dealing 108 (+5% Max HP) Physical Damage.

name: Primal Wrath
description:
Passive: When inside Phylax, Edith accumulates Wrath by dealing skill damage to enemies and taking damage (calculated before damage reduction).
Active: Edith ejects herself forward from Phylax, knocking back nearby enemies and taking flight for up to 8s (gaining 30 Movement Speed). During this time, she gains new skills and can perform ranged Basic Attacks, each dealing 35 (+75% Total Physical Attack) (+25% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. She also gains 350 (+5% Max HP) - 350 (+20% Max HP) extra shield, 50% - 150% extra Attack Speed, and 5% - 20% Hybrid Lifesteal based on accumulated Wrath, and converts each point of Extra and Extra into 3.5 .

name: Divine Retribution
description: Edith exacts Divine Retribution on a target area, dealing 170 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30%. She then continues to deal 68 (+16% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the area every 0.5s over the next 1.5s.

name: Lightning Bolt
description: Edith fires a Lightning Bolt in a designated direction, dealing 150 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hero hit and immobilizing them for 0.8s.

name: Dew
description:
Dew's Lantern will permanently increase Floryn's attributes by a small amount.

After leaving combat for 5s, Floryn can share the Flower of Hope with an allied hero (30s cooldown), which will grant them a 100 (+70% Total Magic Power) shield each time they are healed by Floryn.

Floryn will never sell the Lantern.

name: Sow
description: Floryn tosses an Energy Seed at the target enemy, dealing 180 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Healing Fruits will then spawn and bounce to nearby allied heroes, restoring their HP by 175 (+90% Total Magic Power).

name: Sprout
description: Floryn casts a blob of energy ahead that explodes upon hitting an enemy, dealing 175 (+90% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and stunning them for 0.5s (and revealing their positions briefly).

name: Bloom
description: Floryn resonates with Dew's power, recovering 250 (+100% Total Magic Power) HP for all allied heroes 2 time(s) no matter where they are. This effect also increases their Shield and HP Regen effects by 12% for 2s.

name: Leave It to Me
description: If there are no allied heroes within 4 units of Yin, his damage is increased to 120% and he gains 8% Spell Vamp.

name: Charged Punch
description:
Yin gains 60% extra Movement Speed (decays over 3s).
During this time, his next Basic Attack will be enhanced, dealing 25 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. If the enhanced Basic Attack hits an enemy, Yin throws a charged punch forward, dealing 360 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path.
Successfully throwing the charged punch reduces the skill's cooldown by 35%.

name: Instant Blast
description:
Yin dashes forward, leaving a Golden Ring behind while dealing 75 (+35% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way. He gains 30% extra Damage Reduction for 4s if an enemy hero is hit.
After 1s, the Golden Ring will catch up with Yin, dealing 150 (+70% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies it passes through and stunning them for 1s.

name: My Turn
description:
After a short delay, Yin locks onto an enemy hero (cannot lock onto pets or clones) and pulls them into a domain for up to 8s and turns into Lieh. When in the domain, the two cannot be affected by other heroes' skills.

Lieh has stronger skills and 50 extra and that last 8s.
The domain will end early if either of the two is killed. If Lieh successfully kills the enemy, he'll recover 20% of his Max HP, leave the domain with the cooldowns of Frenzy Strike and Instant Blast reset, and continue to fight as Lieh for 8s.
If Yin fails to pull his target into the domain, the skill will enter a 3s cooldown.

name: Frenzy Strike
description:
Lieh smashes enemies forward 9 times. During this time, he is immune to control effects, and his smashing speed gradually increases. Each smash deals 120 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slows enemies by 75% for 0.2s.
After 0.8s, Lieh can move or cast skills to cancel the skill early.

name: Instant Blast
description:
Lieh strikes a flying kick forward, leaving a Golden Ring behind while dealing 75 (+35% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way. Enemies hit will also be knocked back slightly. He gains 30% extra Damage Reduction for 4s if an enemy hero is hit.
After 1s, the Golden Ring will catch up with Lieh, dealing 150 (+70% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies it passes through and stunning them for 1s.

name: Doll Buster
description:
"My tailor shop excels at fixing and 'fixing' dolls. Am I right, Muddles?"

(Melissa deals 125% damage to Minions, Creeps, and Summoned Units.)

name: Falling!
description:
"Watch me slide forward and boost Attack Speed for 2.5 seconds— Ah, that was just boring…"

"Muddles, go that way!"
"Cuddles, come here!"

name: Eyes on You!
description:
The plan's like this: Throw Muddles out to hold down the bad guys, and then… I come on stage!
"I puncture the bad guys, while Giggles hit Muddles to punish them as well! Hee, fantastic!"

(Muddles deals 175 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage on the first hit and links nearby enemies for up to 6s. Linked enemies are slowed by 60% that decays over 1.5s and can break the link by moving out of the range. Muddles will return to Melissa early when there are no enemies around and immediately if she's too far away. When Muddles is present, you can tap the Attack Minion button to directly attack Muddles, though it cannot trigger the multi-hit damage. Giggles only hits Muddles when Melissa has a target for her Basic Attack.)

name: Go Away!
description:
"Cuddles, protect me! For 4 seconds, let no bad guys come close. Unless I say otherwise!"

(Upon activation, Melissa gains a 300 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) shield and knocks back enemies in the area, dealing 500 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Enemies attempting to enter the field are knocked back, taking 50 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowed briefly. Movement skills are interrupted unless the target has Control Immunity.
The field will move with Melissa once, when she's about to move out of the boundary.)

name: Transcendence
description:
When Xavier's skills hit enemy heroes, he gains 50% Movement Speed for 1.2s (decays over time) and 1 energy charge. At 3 charges, his next skill triggers the Transcendence state.

Transcendence: In this state, Xavier's Skills 1 and 2 have their cooldowns reduced by 4s, and his Ultimate by 36s. Transcendence lasts 5s and can be extended by 1s each time his skills hit enemies.

name: Infinite Extension
description:
Xavier fires a Mystic Bullet that deals 480 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies it passes through.

The Bullet's flying distance increases each time it hits an enemy or the Mystic Barrier (up to 5 times).

name: Mystic Field
description:
Xavier summons a Mystic Barrier that lasts 5s. Enemies touching the Barrier take 220 (+65% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and are slowed by 50%, while allies gain 50% extra Movement Speed (decays over 1.2s).

When hit by Xavier's other skills, the Barrier expands into a Mystic Field for 3s, dealing 220 (+65% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies within and immobilizing them for 0.8s.

name: Dawning Light
description:
Xavier unleashes a beam of Mystic magic in the target direction, dealing 600 (+180% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies along its path.

Once cast, he also directly enters the Transcendence state and resets the state's duration.

name: Smith's Legacy
description:
After casting two different skills, Julian enhances his third skill. Casting the enhanced skill makes all his skills go on a 9-6s Cooldown (decreases with his level).
After casting any skill, his Basic Attacks for the next 2s will deal 100 (+100% Total Physical Attack) (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and pull the target toward him (deals 85% damage to Creeps). Casting another skill extends the duration.
Julian gains 15% extra Hybrid Lifesteal for 5s each time he hits an enemy hero with his skills (up to 3 stacks).

name: Scythe
description:
Julian hurls a flying scythe in the target direction, dealing 420 (+140% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies along the way and slowing them by 30% for 1s.
The scythe disappears upon hitting a non-minion enemy.

name: Sword
description: Julian summons a flying sword and dashes in the target direction, dealing 400 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies along the way.

name: Chain
description: Julian casts chains at the target location, dealing 300 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit after a short delay and immobilizing them for 1.2s.

name: Enhanced Scythe
description:
Julian hurls enhanced scythes in the target direction, dealing 420 (+140% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies along the way and slowing them by 50% for 1s.
Upon hitting a non-minion enemy or reaching the maximum distance, the scythes will continue to fly at a lower speed, dealing 80 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.3s to nearby enemies (up to 8 times).

name: Enhanced Sword
description:
Julian summons a large number of flying swords and dashes in the target direction, dealing 75 (+15% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.1s to enemies along the way (up to 9 times).
Julian's untargetable and invisible during the dash.

name: Enhanced Chain
description:
Julian casts chains at the target location, dealing 40 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.2s to enemies hit and slowing them by 30%.
Enemies that are still in the area at the end of the skill duration will take 250 (+100% Total Magic Power) extra Magic Damage and be knocked airborne for 0.8s.

name: Crystalline Armor
description:
Fredrinn gains 1 Combo Point that lasts 5s each time his skill hits a non-minion enemy, up to 4 Combo Points. His Ultimates cost different numbers of Combo Points.

Fredrinn stores 100% of the damage he receives as Crystal Energy, which decays after 5s at a rate of 10% per second.
Fredrinn can convert the stored Crystal Energy into HP by 20% of his damage dealt (10% for damage dealt to minions). Gaining a Combo Point resets the decaying timer.

name: Piercing Strike
description:
Fredrinn thrusts his sword in the target direction, dealing 125 (+7% Max HP) (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 2s. His next Basic Attack gains extra attack range and deals 85 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
This skill deals 170% damage to non-hero enemies.

name: Brave Assault
description: Fredrinn dashes in the target direction, dealing 140 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first non-minion enemy hit. His next Basic Attack knocks the target airborne for 0.3s.

name: Energy Eruption
description:
Fredrinn deals 210 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and taunts them for 1s. Hitting a non-minion enemy grants Fredrinn 25 for 3s and reduces the cooldowns of Piercing Strike and Brave Assault by 75%.
This skill costs 1 Combo Point.

name: Appraiser's Wrath
description:
Fredrinn slams his sword in the target direction (this skill can only be interrupted by Suppression), dealing 600 plus 21% of his Crystal Energy as Physical Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area after a short delay. Enemies in the center of the area take 175% damage. This skill doubles the conversion ratio based on damage dealt to enemy heroes from stored Crystal Energy to HP.
This skill costs 3 Combo Points.

name: Humph, Joy's Angry!
description:
Joy becomes Angry! each time her skill hits a non-Minion enemy, dealing 100 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and increasing her Movement Speed by 60% that decays over 4s (hitting the Leonin Crystal will also grant the Movement Speed effect). This effect has a cooldown of 4s for each target.

Joy's Basic Attack will deal 65 (+65% Total Physical Attack) (+65% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.

name: Look, Leonin Crystal!
description: Joy summons a Leonin Crystal at the target location, dealing 200 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 30% for 1s. The Leonin Crystal lasts up to 2s.

name: Meow, Rhythm of Joy!
description:
Joy dashes in the target direction, dealing 120 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in her path. Hitting an enemy or the Leonin Crystal allows Joy to cast this skill again within 0.8s and gain 1 Beat Energy. Casting this skill on the beat increases the skill damage by 100% and grants a 80 (+60% Total Magic Power) shield that lasts 3s.

This skill can be cast up to 4 times in succession.

name: Ha, Electrifying Beats!
description:
Joy gains 15 (+10% Total Magic Power) and 30% Movement Speed. Over the next 3s, she pulses 8 times, dealing 120 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage each time to nearby enemies.
Each Meow, Rhythm of Joy! cast on the beat increases this skill's damage by 40%. If perfect rhythm is achieved by hitting every beat with Meow, Rhythm of Joy!, Joy also gains 40% Spell Vamp while this skill is active.

This skill unlocks when Joy acquires Beat Energy. Casting this skill with 3 Beat Energy will remove all debuffs and make her immune to slow effects while this skill is active.

name: Star Trail
description: Astral Sphere continuously slows nearby enemies by 20% and reveals their position.

name: Astral Meteor
description: Novaria summons an Astral Sphere at the target location, dealing 75 (+25% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.33s and continuously slowing enemies (up to 2.5 times). After 2s, the Astral Sphere explodes, dealing 260 (+50% Total Magic Power) (+ 4% target's ) Magic Damage and slowing enemies by 2.5 times.

name: Astral Recall
description:
First Cast: Novaria summons an Astral Sphere at a distance and draws it toward her. She gains 80% Movement Speed (decays to 30%) and can pass through obstacles.

Use Again: Upon catching the Astral Sphere, she can cast Star Shatter to launch it in the target direction within 5s. Upon hitting an enemy hero, it deals 260 (+95% Total Magic Power) (+ 5% target's ) Magic Damage to them and nearby heroes. The damage will increase based on the Astral Sphere's travel distance (draw + launch), up to 2.2 times the original damage.

name: Astral Echo
description: Novaria scatters Astral Echo in the target direction, briefly slowing enemy heroes hit by 50% and applying Astral Ring on them. This increases their hitbox by 2.5 times and reveals their position for 5s.

name: Demon Gaze
description:
Arlott possesses a demonic eye that will Mark enemy units near Arlott that become affected by control effects for 7s.
The eye will also automatically Mark a nearby enemy hero in vision every 7s.

name: Dauntless Strike
description: Arlott swings his lance forward, dealing 200 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and briefly stunning targets in an area. Targets hit by the farther part of the AOE will be stunned for 1s instead.

name: Vengeance
description:
Arlott charges at an enemy, dealing 135 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage (this skill cannot be interrupted during movement).
If Arlott's target is Marked, he gains a brief burst of Movement Speed, and this skill will deal double damage, immediately refresh its cooldown, and recover 70 (+60% Total Physical Attack) HP to Arlott (only restores 50% of that amount when used on a non-hero unit).

name: Final Slash
description:
Passive: Each level-up reduces Demon Gaze's interval by 1s.
Active: Arlott cleaves forward, dealing 400 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area, knocking them back to the edge of the swing, and briefly revealing their location (can only be interrupted by Suppression).

name: Siphon Starlium
description:
Ixia's Basic Attacks and skills apply a stack of Starlium Charge to enemies on hit. When Ixia performs a Basic Attack on an enemy with two stacks of Starlium Charge, the attack consumes the stacks and is replaced by Siphon Starlium, dealing (+150% Total Physical Attack) +(+10*Hero Level) Physical Damage to the target. Ixia recovers HP equal to the damage dealt (only 10 % against non-hero units) and slows the target by 25% for 1s.
Siphon Starlium can hit all enemies in front of Ixia within her Basic Attack range, but it cannot Crit.
Ixia's Basic Attacks cannot trigger Lifesteal.

name: Dual Beam
description:
Ixia fires 2 Starlium-charged energy beams along the ground in the target direction, dealing 100 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a rectangular area. When hitting enemy heroes, Ixia gains 50% Movement Speed for 2s.
Enemies hit by both beams will take double damage.

name: Star Helix
description: Ixia unleashes a canister of Starlium energy in the target direction, knocking back nearby enemies. After a short delay, it pulls enemies in range to the center line and deals 200 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

name: Full Barrage
description: Ixia reassembles her weapon into 6 smaller weapons and enters the Full Barrage state for 4s. In this state, Ixia's Basic Attacks and skills can hit enemies in the large fan-shaped area in front of her, but not outside it. Ixia's Basic Attacks can hit up to 6 enemy units (prioritizes heroes), and Siphon Starlium will fire simultaneously with her normal Basic Attacks.

name: Dimensional Rift
description:
Nolan's skills will leave a Rift. When a rift comes into contact with another rift, they will activate and pull enemies to their center and deal 240 (+140% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage after a short delay. Each time a rift activation hits an enemy, Nolan will gain 25 Energy. If an enemy is hit by multiple rift activations, the damage after the first hit will be reduced by 40%.
Cosmic Leap: If Nolan does not deal or take damage for 5s, he enhances his next Basic Attack to dash to the target, dealing (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and leaving a Rift. (Damage to and from Minions or Creeps will not prevent Nolan from getting this effect.)

name: Expansion
description: Nolan cuts a rectangular area in front of him with his cosmic gauge, dealing 230 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and leaving a Rift at the first enemy hit.

name: Gauge
description: Nolan charges in the target direction and slashes with his cosmic gauge, dealing 70 (+13% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in his path and leaving a Rift.

name: Fracture
description: Nolan slashes at the target location 3 times, dealing 120 (+50% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage with each slash while leaving 3 rifts and slowing the target hit by 30% for 0.5s. The rifts will be activated automatically while Nolan dashes backward.

name: Performer's Delight
description: Cici generates a stack of Delight after dealing damage, increasing her Movement Speed by 0.75% and Spell Vamp by 1.25% per stack up to 10 times, doubling the effects at full stacks.

name: Yo-Yo Blitz
description:
Cici uses Yoyo to continuously attack the nearest enemy within range (prioritizing heroes) for 3.5s, hitting them up to 10 times, and dealing Physical Damage equal to 65 plus 3.5 (+1.2% Extra Physical Attack)% of the target's per hit. Cici can move and use other skills during this attack.

If there is no enemy within range, Yoyo will attack Turrets or the Base instead.

This skill deals 20% extra damage to Minions.

name: Buoyant Bounce
description: Cici leaps to a target location. If she lands on any unit (not including Turrets and Base), she can leap again in the Joystick's direction. If she lands on an enemy with the first leap, she deals 200 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to them.

name: Curtain Call
description:
Cici throws Yoyo at the target enemy hero and links them with another nearby enemy hero, dealing 100 (+10% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, slowing them by 30%, and pulling them together for 4s.

During this time, Cici can use Yo-Yo Blitz to attack both linked targets at the same time. If only one target is within the range of Yo-Yo Blitz, Cici will attack the target twice, but the damage of the second attack will be reduced to 25%.

name: Snack Time!
description:
While out of combat, Chip takes a bite of potato chips every 2s. After 4 bites, he finishes a bag and recovers HP equal to 300 (+ 45% of his lost ).

After finishing a bag, Chip cannot eat again for 5s. (His bite count is retained if he enters combat before finishing the bag.)

name: Crash Course
description: Chip rams his hovercraft into the ground, dealing Magic Damage equal to 100 plus 4% of the target's and applying Chip's Mark on enemy units hit. Chip gains a 300 (+60% Total Magic Power) Shield upon hitting an enemy hero, which increases by 40% for each additional enemy hero hit. Chip's next Basic Attack will become ranged and also hit all nearby enemies with Chip's Mark, detonating the mark to deal 150 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and stun each target for 0.6s.

name: Overtime
description:
Chip rushes for 2s, gaining up to 65% extra Movement Speed, after which he maintains the max speed for 2s.

Chip's next Basic Attack will cause him to charge at the enemy, dealing 200 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and knocking them back slightly.

name: Shortcut
description:
Chip drops the Main Portal on an enemy hero, dealing 200 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and briefly slowing them by 25%. The Main Portal deals 2 times the damage and immobilizes them for 1s after a delay. Meanwhile, he creates Connecting Portals near allied heroes 10 units away and behind the allied Base. The Main Portal and Connecting Portals last up to 15s.
Connecting Portal: Heroes (on both teams) can teleport from Connecting Portals to the Main Portal, and allied heroes gain Burst Movement Speed for 1.5s and a 500 shield.
Main Portal: The Main Portal inherits 70% of Chip's attributes. Heroes can stand on the Main Portal for 2s to return to the Connecting Portal they came from. Casting skills or launching Basic Attacks will reset the stand time.

name: Why Walk?
description: Chip has 4 fixed Beacons on the map when the battle starts. Use this skill to teleport to any other Beacon. (This skill cannot be used in combat.)

name: Crimson Butterflies
description:
Every time Zhuxin channels Lantern Flare, she converts the Mana spent into up to 15 Crimson Butterflies to follow her Spirit Lantern. After Zhuxin stops channeling Lantern Flare, the Crimson Butterflies will gradually disappear, each restoring 5% of her Max Mana.
Zhuxin has a naturally high base Max Mana, but it doesn't scale with her level.

name: Fluttering Grace
description: Zhuxin deals 150 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies in a fan-shaped area and applies 1 stack(s) of Soul Snare. Zhuxin also slows all enemy heroes hit by 20% and gains 20% of extra Movement Speed herself for 1.5s.

name: Lantern Flare
description:
Hold: Hold the skill button to move the Spirit Lantern. It deals 35 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies in range every 0.33s (Magic Bonus increases to 60% against minions) and applies Soul Snare to enemy heroes hit. When an enemy hero reaches 10 stacks of Soul Snare, the Crimson Butterflies capture them, pulling them airborne for 1s.

Release: Throw all captured enemies to the target location, dealing 200 (+150% Total Magic Power) (+ 10% captured target's ) Magic Damage to all enemies in the area. If an enemy is hit multiple times, subsequent damage decays by 80%.

After a target is captured, Soul Snare cannot stack on them again for 4s. During this time, this skill deals 15% extra damage to that target.

name: Crimson Beacon
description: Zhuxin blinks to the target location, gaining a 400 (+100% Total Magic Power) shield and creating a field for 6s. The field deals 30 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and applies 1 stack of Soul Snare to nearby enemies every 0.5s.

name: Transient Immortal
description:
Tap-casting any skill puts Suyou in Mortal Form, granting 40 Movement Speed and reducing the interval between his Basic Attacks.
Hold-casting any skill puts Suyou in Immortal Form, increasing his Basic Attack damage to 125% and granting 20% Physical Damage Reduction.
In this form, Suyou gains 1% Physical Damage Reduction for every 20 extra he has, up to 40%.

name: Blade Surge
description:
Tap: Suyou throws his weapon in the target direction, dealing 250 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path. Suyou then blinks to the weapon's location, catches it, and performs a slash in the opposite direction, dealing 375 (+150% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
Hold: Suyou channels the Immortal's power and charges in the target direction, dealing 250 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the path. When hitting an enemy hero, he stops and stuns enemies in a rectangular area in front for 0.6s. The charge distance increases with the hold time.
Suyou can be controlled while charging, but the skill cannot be interrupted.

name: Soul Sever
description:
Tap: Suyou performs a sweeping attack with his weapon, dealing Physical Damage equal to 280 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) (+ 15% of target's lost ) to enemies in a fan-shaped area.

Hold: Suyou channels the power of the Immortal to perform 3 cleaves in a fan-shaped area. The first two strikes deal 225 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage each, while the final strike deals 360 (+128% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and recovers 150 (+50% Extra Physical Attack) HP for himself.

name: Evil Queller
description:
Tap: Suyou glides backward and swings his weapon in the target direction, dealing 420 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a rectangular area and on his path backward, and reducing their Movement Speed by 30% for 1.5s.
Hold: Suyou uses the Immortal's power to shoot a deadly arrow in the target direction, dealing 580 (+165% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target hit. The range increases with the hold time.
Suyou can be controlled while charging, but the skill cannot be interrupted.

name: Hero's Resolve
description:
Lukas gains 0.5 Resolve per second and 3.5 Resolve when dealing damage to heroes.
Upon reaching 100 Resolve, he can use Unleash the Beast to transform into Sacred Beast.

Sacred Beast: Greatly increases combat attributes. He continuously consumes Resolve and ends when Resolve is depleted.

name: Flash Combo
description:
Passive: Basic Attacks grant Vigor (up to 2 stacks), each stack lasting 4s. Vigor enhances Flash Combo.
Lukas consumes all Vigor to unleash Pulverize, dealing 280 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and recovering 6% of his when hitting a hero or minion.
1 Stack: Lukas briefly stuns the target and spins his tonfa hammers to deal 80 (+45% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage 3 times, pulling the enemy toward him.
2 Stacks: Lukas briefly stuns the target, then delivers 2 attacks dealing 50 (+20% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage each. Afterward, he spins his tonfa hammers, dealing 80 (+45% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage 3 times while gaining Control Immunity for the duration.

name: Flash Step
description:
Lukas dashes in the target direction, empowering his next Basic Attack within 4s into Flash Strike.

Flash Strike: Lukas dashes behind the enemy, dealing 60 (+125% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. He then gains 20% Movement Speed and Attack Speed for 4s. During this time, his next Basic Attack gains increased Attack Range and triggers a sacred lightning that deals 110 (+50% Total Physical Attack) extra Physical Damage.

name: Unleash the Beast
description:
First Cast: Lukas transforms into his Sacred Beast form (briefly gains Control Immunity). His base Movement Speed is increased by 30, all attributes are increased by 15%, and his skills gain new effects.

Use Again: Fires a Shockwave Blast in the target direction that explodes upon hitting an enemy hero or reaching its maximum range, dealing 450 (+155% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

All attributes: , , , , Attack Speed, and Attack Range.

name: Flash Combo
description:
Passive: Basic Attacks grant Vigor (up to 2 stacks), each stack lasting 4s. Vigor enhances Flash Combo.
Lukas consumes all Vigor to unleash a tail swing, dealing 280 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and recovering 6% of his when hitting a hero.
1 Stack: Lukas briefly stuns the target and pounces, dealing 80 (+45% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage 3 times and knocking the enemy back.
2 Stacks: Lukas briefly stuns the target and leaps, dealing 50 (+20% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage 2 times. Afterward, he summons sacred lightning, dealing 80 (+45% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage 3 times while gaining Control Immunity for the duration.

name: Flash Step
description:
Lukas dashes in the target direction, empowering his next Basic Attack within 4s into Lightning Clash.

Lightning Clash: Lukas charges toward the enemy, knocking them back and dealing 60 (+125% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. He then gains 20% Movement Speed and Attack Speed for 4s. During this time, his next Basic Attack gains increased Attack Range and triggers a sacred lightning that deals 110 (+50% Total Physical Attack) extra Physical Damage.

name: Shockwave Blast
description: The Sacred Beast fires a Shockwave Blast in the target direction (gains Control Immunity during the cast) that will explode upon hitting an enemy hero or reaching its maximum range, dealing 450 (+155% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

name: Surge of Life
description:
After casting a skill, Kalea creates a Water Zone on the ground. When Kalea casts a skill within this zone, she absorbs it to enhance her next 3 Basic Attacks with different effects:
First Basic Attack: Kalea dashes to the target, dealing (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
Second Basic Attack: Kalea unleashes a flurry of attacks, dealing 140 (+8*Hero Level) (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and recovering (+12% Max HP) (+80% Total Magic Power) HP to herself and the nearby ally with the lowest HP.
Third Basic Attack: Kalea strikes around the target with her tail, dealing 70 (+4*Hero Level) (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and creating a new Water Zone.
Enhanced Basic Attacks are not affected by Attack Speed.
Control effects can affect Kalea during the third Enhanced Basic Attack, but cannot interrupt it.

name: Wavebreaker
description: Kalea slams her fist into the ground, creating a wave that deals 200 (+5% Max HP) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and slows them by 40% for 1.5s.

name: Tidal Strike
description:
Kalea charges forward and body slams the first enemy hero she encounters, knocking them airborne for 0.6s (unaffected by Resilience) while dealing 150 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
If she collides with an obstacle or touches the edge of a Water Zone during her charge, Kalea will leap into the air. Cast the skill again to slam down at a target location, dealing 150 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and knocking enemies airborne for 0.6s (unaffected by Resilience).

name: Tsunami Slam
description: Kalea grabs an enemy hero with her tail and slams them down in the Joystick's direction (drag the Joystick to change landing spot). She gains Control Immunity during this process. Upon landing, deals 300 (+8% Max HP) Physical Damage to the target and nearby enemies.

name: Celestial Armament
description:
Phoenix Crown: When Zetian hits enemy heroes with Phoenix Strike or Phoenix Descent, she gains 1% Spell Vamp for 5s (up to 10 stacks).

Celestial Robe: The power of the Phoenix periodically protects Zetian, knocking back and stunning any enemy hero who approaches her, dealing 90 (+10*Hero Level) (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. She also gains a 300 (+20*Hero Level) (+50% Total Magic Power) shield for 3s. Cooldown: 120s.

name: Phoenix Strike
description:
Zetian unleashes a Phoenix Wave in the target direction. If it hits an enemy, she automatically casts another wave (up to 3 times). Zetian can cast other skills during this time.

The waves deal 150 (+50% Total Magic Power), 150 (+50% Total Magic Power), and 360 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, respectively. The 3rd wave has a larger area and pulls enemies toward the cast direction (not considered a control effect).

The Spell Vamp ratio against minions is only 65%.

name: Phoenix Descent
description:
Zetian summons a Phoenix Spirit at the target location, dealing 150 (+45% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and applying a brief 50% slow effect to enemies in the area. The Phoenix Spirit hovers at the location for 3s, dealing 20 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.5s and reducing enemies' by 10% while revealing their surrounding area.
While the Phoenix Spirit is active, Zetian can use this skill again to command it to charge toward a designated location, dealing 150 (+45% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and applying a brief 50% slow effect upon arrival.

name: Fury of the Phoenix
description:
Zetian calls upon her divine mandate and the hearts of her people, granting all allied heroes 40% Movement Speed that gradually decays over 3s, while bringing divine retribution upon all enemy heroes, dealing 400 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and stunning them for 0.8s. Zetian gains vision of all enemy heroes during this time.
Zetian can cast other skills while channeling this skill.

name: Return to Bone
description:
Obsidia gains Bone Energy whenever she deals damage. Basic Attacks grant 1 Energy against non-hero units and 2 against hero units or Turrets. Skills grant Energy equal to 3 times the amount granted by Basic Attacks against the same unit type. No Energy is gained from hitting creeps.
When Bone Energy reaches 30, it forms a Bone Shard, up to 25 shards. When Obsidia uses Basic Attacks, all Bone Shards strike the target, each dealing (+6% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and inheriting 6% Attack Effects.
Killing an enemy hero directly grants 1 Bone Shard(s).
Obsidia's Basic Attacks deal 70 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, inheriting 100% Attack Effects.

name: Abyssal Bone Needle
description: Obsidia launches an Abyssal Bone Needle, dealing 325 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and triggering Return to Bone on the first enemy hero struck.

name: Phantom Shadowmeld
description: Obsidia descends into the Abyss and enters Shadowmeld Form, gaining 500% Movement Speed for 0.3s.

name: Hunt of Bone
description:
Obsidia shoots Bones of Wrath in the target direction, dealing 125 (+60% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and briefly stunning the first enemy hero hit before pulling herself to the target. The Bones of Wrath tethers Obsidia to the enemy, preventing her from moving more than 4 units away. While tethered, the enemy cannot use mobility skills, and their movement drags Obsidia along. Obsidia also gains 5 temporary Bone Shards stacks and a shield equal to 200 (+ 25 per Bone Shard stack). This effect lasts 3s.

While tethered, Obsidia can move through obstacles and use Basic Attacks while moving. Phantom Shadowmeld is also enhanced: its duration increases to 1s, and its cooldown is reduced to 33%.

name: Mystic Surge
description:
Sora can ascend to Thunder or Torrent by using his Ultimate. After ascending, dealing damage to heroes or summoned units grants 1 stack of Cloudstep. Upon reaching 5 stacks, he unlocks his True Art.

Thunder: Adopts an assassin style, converting 30% into (Equal to 10% of ).
Torrent: Adopts a tank style, converting 30% into (Gains 10 HP for every 1 Attack).

name: Sundering Strike
description: Sora strikes twice, dealing 140 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, then lunges forward, dealing 240 (+5% Max HP) Physical Damage. He can dash after striking.

name: Windstride
description: Sora leaps forward, dealing 140 (+55% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. If he hits an enemy hero or reaches max range, he slams the ground, dealing an additional 140 (+8% Max HP) Physical Damage and slowing them by 40% for 0.5s. Successful hits reduce the cooldown by 2s.

name: Shifting Skies
description:
Swipe left to ascend into Thunder for 10s. Sora gains a brief bonus Movement Speed and becomes untargetable. He then summons lightning to strike nearby enemies 3 time(s), each dealing 140 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

Swipe right to ascend into Torrent for 10s. Sora gains Control Immunity. After a short delay, he pulls nearby enemies in and deals 250 (+8% Max HP) Physical Damage.

name: Sundering Strike - Thunderflash
description: Sora strikes four times, dealing 140 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, then lunges forward, dealing 240 (+5% Max HP) Physical Damage. He can move freely during this skill.

name: Windstride - Thunder Rush
description: Sora leaps forward, dealing 120 (+45% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Upon hitting a hero or reaching the max distance, he summons a thunderstorm, dealing 120 (+6% Max HP) Physical Damage and slowing enemies by 50% for 0.5s. This skill can be cast again within 4s if it hits an enemy.

name: Heaven's Wrath
description: Sora leaps into the air and strikes a target area 16 time(s), dealing 60 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage with each hit. Sora can move freely and ignore terrain during this skill.

name: Sundering Strike - Overwhelm
description: Sora strikes twice, dealing 140 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing enemies for 40%. He then lunges forward, dealing 240 (+5% Max HP) Physical Damage, stunning enemies for 0.5s.

name: Windstride - Skyfall
description: Sora leaps forward, dealing 140 (+55% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, knocking enemies airborne, and knocking them back to the landing point. He then smashes the ground, knocking enemies airborne again for 0.5s, dealing 140 (+8% Max HP) Physical Damage, and slowing them by 50% for 1s. Hits reduce cooldown by 2s.

name: Stormbind
description: Sora leaps into the air and strikes the target area 5 time(s), dealing 100 (+6% Max HP) Physical Damage and briefly stunning enemies with each hit. Sora can move freely and ignore terrain during this skill.

name: Platinum Snap
description:
Marcel's split soul, Clemar, enters the camera to freeze the moment. His Basic Attacks deal 50 (+40% Total Physical Attack)(+40% Total Magic Defense)(+40% Total Physical Defense) Physical Damage. His Extra is converted into 1.5% .

Clemar automatically snaps photos of enemy heroes near Marcel, causing a brief Frozen Moment and dealing 20 (+ 5% of ) True Damage (triggers Attack Effects). It also grants a shield of the same value to Marcel and a nearby allied hero. Cooldown: 12s per target.

name: Framed Moment
description:
Clemar focuses on an area around Marcel, slowing enemy heroes within by 60%.
After 2.5s, he completes the shot, dealing 300 (+50% Total Physical Attack)(+120% Total Magic Defense)(+120% Total Physical Defense) Physical Damage to enemies within.

name: Tracking Shot
description:
Artist inspiration time! Marcel enters the Tracking Haste state for 3s, gaining 15% Movement Speed. This bonus increases to 75% when moving toward an enemy hero.

Use Again: Marcel dashes in the target direction, leaving a framing phantom behind while the Framed Moment area remains at the original location.

name: Golden Hour
description:
Marcel and Clemar perform a joint shoot. After a short delay, Clemar takes a wide-angle shot of the target area for 2s. During this time, Marcel enters the Tracking Haste state while inside the area. All other units in the area are put into a Frozen Moment and are immune to all effects except from Marcel. All projectiles are also frozen and will continue after a delay (targeted projectiles will deal 50% damage).

Golden Hour resets the cooldown of Platinum Snap for each enemy hero.
Allied heroes with the Platinum Snap shield can move freely within the area.

name: Twin Fans: Ukifune
description:
Hirara has only two skills, representing her two weapons: Meisen-e and Kaerazu. Drag one skill onto the other to cast a combo skill.

Hirara has 2 Crimson / Death Energy. Casting a combo skill consumes 1 Crimson / Death Energy. Energy recovery time is the same as the cooldown of Meisen-e. Consuming Energy interrupts the recovery process.

Hirara only deals 30 (+4*Hero Level)% damage to minions.

name: Meisen-e
description: Hirara rides the waves using Meisen-e, performing up to two joystick dashes (the first dash goes in her facing direction). She deals 150 (+50% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit.

name: Kaerazu
description:
Hirara uses Kaerazu to unleash the Crimson Maple, dealing 150 (+65% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area.

After a short delay, she deals damage again at the target location, dealing 2 times the initial Crimson Maple damage.

name: Falling Maple
description:
Hirara enhances Kaerazu with the power of Meisen-e to cast a combo skill.
She becomes untargetable and immobilized for up to 1s.
After 0.6s, she deals 3 times Crimson Maple damage, and can then cast the second joystick dash of Meisen-e to end these states early.

name: Infernal Torrent
description:
Hirara enhances Meisen-e with the power of Kaerazu to cast a combo skill.
After casting the first joystick dash of Meisen-e, she spins, dealing 2.5 times the Crimson Maple damage and immobilizing enemies for 0.8s.
